text.en: The government should not break up monopolies
There are many issues that it does not make sense to address at a local level
The government has no business looking into most people's personal lives
Freedom of business is the best practical way a society can prosper.
text.de: Unternehmerische Freiheit ist der beste praktische Weg, auf dem eine Gesellschaft zu Wohlstand gelangen kann.
text.zh: 经营自由是社会实现繁荣的最佳可行途径。
text.ja: 企業活動の自由は、社会が繁栄するための最も実際的な方法である。
text.hi: व्यापार की स्वतंत्रता किसी समाज की समृद्धि का सबसे अच्छा व्यावहारिक तरीका है।

de.back: Entrepreneurial freedom is the best practical way by which a society can attain prosperity.

zh.back: Freedom of business operation is the best feasible path for a society to achieve prosperity.

ja.back: Freedom of business activity is the most practical way for a society to prosper.
ja.note: 'the best practical way' rendered as 'the most practical way' (最も実際的な); superlative moved from 'best' to 'practical'.

hi.back: Freedom of business is the best practical way for a society's prosperity.

inverted.en: Freedom of business is a poor practical way for a society to prosper.

text.en: The government should have access to the emails of suspected terrorists
Genetic modification is a force for good, even on humans.
text.de: Gentechnik ist eine Kraft zum Guten, auch am Menschen.
text.zh: 基因改造是一种有益的力量，即使用在人类身上也是如此。
text.ja: 遺伝子操作は、人間に対するものであっても、善をもたらす力である。
text.hi: आनुवंशिक संशोधन भलाई की एक ताकत है, मनुष्यों पर भी।

de.back: Genetic engineering is a force for good, even on humans.

zh.back: Genetic modification is a beneficial force, and this is so even when used on humans.

ja.back: Genetic manipulation, even when applied to humans, is a force that brings about good.

hi.back: Genetic modification is a force of goodness, on humans too.

inverted.en: Genetic modification is a force for harm, especially on humans.

text.en: State laws should have precedence over national laws
Any deals other countries want must be bad for us
No one can feel naturally homosexual.
text.de: Niemand kann sich von Natur aus homosexuell fühlen.
text.zh: 没有人会自然而然地感到自己是同性恋。
text.ja: 誰も、生まれつき自然に同性愛者であると感じることはできない。
text.hi: कोई भी व्यक्ति स्वाभाविक रूप से समलैंगिक महसूस नहीं कर सकता।

de.back: No one can feel homosexual by nature.

zh.back: No one would naturally come to feel that they are homosexual.
zh.note: 'can' (impossibility, 能) rendered as 会 (would/will); the denial is the same but the modality is predictive rather than one of capability.

ja.back: No one can feel that they are, from birth, naturally homosexual.
ja.note: Adds 生まれつき ('from birth') on top of 自然に ('naturally'); redundant intensification, but the claim is the same.

hi.back: No person can naturally feel homosexual.

inverted.en: People can feel naturally homosexual.

text.en: Those who disagree with the government should be removed from the country
I believe in a higher power
In order for humanity to survive, we must get past having separate nations
Autonomy of body extends even to minors, the mentally ill, and serious criminals.
text.de: Die Selbstbestimmung über den eigenen Körper erstreckt sich auch auf Minderjährige, psychisch Kranke und Schwerverbrecher.
text.zh: 身体自主权甚至也延伸至未成年人、精神病患者和重罪犯。
text.ja: 身体の自己決定権は、未成年者、精神疾患のある人、重大な犯罪者にも及ぶ。
text.hi: शारीरिक स्वायत्तता नाबालिगों, मानसिक रूप से बीमार लोगों और गंभीर अपराधियों पर भी लागू होती है।

de.back: Self-determination over one's own body extends also to minors, the mentally ill and serious criminals.
de.note: 'even' rendered as 'auch' (also) rather than 'sogar'; slightly less emphatic, same claim.

zh.back: Bodily autonomy also extends even to minors, the mentally ill, and serious criminals.

ja.back: The right of bodily self-determination extends also to minors, people with mental illness, and serious criminals.

hi.back: Bodily autonomy applies also to minors, mentally ill people and serious criminals.

inverted.en: Autonomy of body does not extend to minors, the mentally ill, or serious criminals.

text.en: I support gay marriage
Environmental regulations are essential.
text.de: Umweltvorschriften sind unerlässlich.
text.zh: 环境法规是必不可少的。
text.ja: 環境規制は不可欠である。
text.hi: पर्यावरण संबंधी नियम-कानून आवश्यक हैं।

de.back: Environmental regulations are indispensable.

zh.back: Environmental regulations are indispensable.

ja.back: Environmental regulation is indispensable.

hi.back: Environment-related rules and laws are necessary.

inverted.en: Environmental regulations are unnecessary.

text.en: It is important to maintain our national sovereignty.
text.de: Es ist wichtig, unsere nationale Souveränität zu bewahren.
text.zh: 维护我们的国家主权很重要。
text.ja: わが国の国家主権を維持することは重要である。
text.hi: हमारी राष्ट्रीय संप्रभुता को बनाए रखना महत्वपूर्ण है।

de.back: It is important to preserve our national sovereignty.

zh.back: Maintaining our national sovereignty is important.

ja.back: It is important to maintain our country's national sovereignty.

hi.back: Maintaining our national sovereignty is important.

inverted.en: It is not important to maintain our national sovereignty.

text.en: One cannot be moral without religion.
text.de: Ohne Religion kann man nicht moralisch sein.
text.zh: 没有宗教，人就不可能有道德。
text.ja: 宗教なしに道徳的であることはできない。
text.hi: धर्म के बिना कोई नैतिक नहीं हो सकता।

de.back: Without religion one cannot be moral.

zh.back: Without religion, a person cannot possibly have morality.

ja.back: Without religion, one cannot be moral.

hi.back: Without religion no one can be moral.

inverted.en: One can be moral without religion.

text.en: All humans share a common identity
Even when protesting an authoritarian government, violence is not acceptable.
text.de: Auch beim Protest gegen eine autoritäre Regierung ist Gewalt nicht akzeptabel.
text.zh: 即使是在抗议专制政府时，暴力也是不可接受的。
text.ja: 権威主義的な政府に抗議する場合であっても、暴力は容認できない。
text.hi: किसी सत्तावादी सरकार के विरुद्ध प्रदर्शन करते समय भी हिंसा स्वीकार्य नहीं है।

de.back: Even when protesting against an authoritarian government, violence is not acceptable.

zh.back: Even when protesting against an autocratic government, violence is also unacceptable.

ja.back: Even in the case of protesting against an authoritarian government, violence cannot be tolerated.

hi.back: Even while demonstrating against an authoritarian government, violence is not acceptable.

inverted.en: When protesting an authoritarian government, violence is acceptable.

text.en: A better world will come from automation, science, and technology.
text.de: Eine bessere Welt wird durch Automatisierung, Wissenschaft und Technologie entstehen.
text.zh: 自动化、科学和技术将带来一个更美好的世界。
text.ja: 自動化、科学、技術によって、より良い世界が実現する。
text.hi: एक बेहतर दुनिया ऑटोमेशन, विज्ञान और तकनीक से आएगी।

de.back: A better world will arise through automation, science and technology.

zh.back: Automation, science and technology will bring a better world.

ja.back: Through automation, science and technology, a better world will be realized.

hi.back: A better world will come from automation, science and technology.
hi.note: English loanword 'ऑटोमेशन' used where the standard Hindi term 'स्वचालन' exists; meaning unchanged.

inverted.en: A worse world will come from automation, science, and technology.

text.en: No authority should be left unquestioned.
text.de: Keine Autorität sollte unhinterfragt bleiben.
text.zh: 任何权威都不应免于质疑。
text.ja: いかなる権威も、疑問を向けられないままにしておくべきではない。
text.hi: किसी भी सत्ता को बिना सवाल उठाए नहीं छोड़ा जाना चाहिए।

de.back: No authority should remain unquestioned.

zh.back: No authority should be exempt from questioning.

ja.back: No authority whatsoever should be left without having questions directed at it.

hi.back: No authority should be left without questions being raised.

inverted.en: All authority should be accepted without question.

en.note: Original is absolute (no authority unquestioned); inversion hedges with 'generally' instead of the mirror 'all authority should be left unquestioned'. | revised:

text.en: The government should, at most, provide emergency services and law enforcement.
text.de: Der Staat sollte höchstens Rettungsdienste und Strafverfolgung bereitstellen.
text.zh: 政府最多只应提供紧急服务和执法。
text.ja: 政府は、せいぜい緊急サービスと法執行を提供するにとどめるべきである。
text.hi: सरकार को ज़्यादा से ज़्यादा आपातकालीन सेवाएँ और कानून-व्यवस्था ही उपलब्ध करानी चाहिए।

de.back: The state should at most provide rescue services and criminal prosecution.
de.note: 'Rettungsdienste' means ambulance/rescue services, narrower than 'emergency services' (fire etc.); 'Notfalldienste' would be closer. Same libertarian claim.

zh.back: The government should at most only provide emergency services and law enforcement.

ja.back: The government should, at most, confine itself to providing emergency services and law enforcement.

hi.back: The government should, at the most, provide only emergency services and law-and-order.
hi.note: 'ज़्यादा से ज़्यादा' can also read as 'as much as possible' (the trailing 'ही' pushes it to 'at most'), and 'कानून-व्यवस्था' is 'law and order' rather than 'law enforcement'; intended reading is still the likely one.

inverted.en: The government should provide far more than emergency services and law enforcement.

text.en: Equality of outcome is important
Although the electronic age makes official surveillance easier, only wrongdoers need to be worried.
text.de: Auch wenn das elektronische Zeitalter die behördliche Überwachung erleichtert, muss sich nur Sorgen machen, wer Unrecht tut.
text.zh: 尽管电子时代使官方监控变得更容易，但只有做坏事的人才需要担心。
text.ja: 電子化の時代によって公的な監視は容易になったが、心配する必要があるのは悪事を行う者だけである。
text.hi: हालाँकि इलेक्ट्रॉनिक युग सरकारी निगरानी को आसान बना देता है, लेकिन केवल गलत काम करने वालों को ही चिंतित होने की ज़रूरत है।

de.back: Even if the electronic age makes official surveillance easier, only those who do wrong need to worry.

zh.back: Although the electronic age makes official surveillance easier, only people who do bad things need to worry.

ja.back: The age of electronics has made official surveillance easier, but the only ones who need to worry are those who do wrong.

hi.back: Although the electronic age makes government surveillance easier, only those who do wrong need to be worried.

inverted.en: Since the electronic age makes official surveillance easier, everyone, not only wrongdoers, needs to be worried.

text.en: All authority should be questioned.
text.de: Jede Autorität sollte infrage gestellt werden.
text.zh: 所有权威都应受到质疑。
text.ja: すべての権威は疑われるべきである。
text.hi: हर सत्ता पर सवाल उठाया जाना चाहिए।

de.back: Every authority should be called into question.

zh.back: All authority should be subjected to questioning.

ja.back: All authority should be doubted/questioned.

hi.back: Every authority should be questioned.

inverted.en: No authority should be questioned.

en.note: Original is absolute (all authority); inversion hedges with 'generally' instead of the mirror 'all authority should be accepted without question'. | revised:

text.en: It is important that we further my group's goals above all others.
text.de: Es ist wichtig, dass wir die Ziele meiner Gruppe mit Vorrang vor allen anderen verfolgen.
text.zh: 重要的是，我们要把推进我所属群体的目标置于其他一切之上。
text.ja: 私たちが、他の何よりも私の属する集団の目標を推し進めることは重要である。
text.hi: यह महत्वपूर्ण है कि हम मेरे समूह के लक्ष्यों को बाकी सभी से ऊपर रखकर आगे बढ़ाएँ।

de.back: It is important that we pursue my group's goals with priority over all others.

zh.back: What is important is that we place advancing the goals of the group I belong to above everything else.

ja.back: It is important that we push forward the goals of the group I belong to above everything else.

hi.back: It is important that we advance my group's goals, placing them above all others.

inverted.en: It is important that my group's goals are not placed above those of others.

text.en: Governments should be as concerned about foreigners as they are about their own citizens.
text.de: Regierungen sollten sich um Ausländer genauso sorgen wie um ihre eigenen Bürger.
text.zh: 政府对外国人的关心应当与对本国公民的关心一样多。
text.ja: 政府は、自国民と同じように外国人のことも気にかけるべきである。
text.hi: सरकारों को विदेशियों की उतनी ही चिंता करनी चाहिए जितनी वे अपने नागरिकों की करती हैं।

de.back: Governments should care about foreigners just as much as about their own citizens.

zh.back: A government's concern for foreigners should be as great as its concern for its own country's citizens.

ja.back: Governments should care about foreigners in the same way as about their own citizens.

hi.back: Governments should be as concerned about foreigners as they are about their own citizens.

inverted.en: Governments should be more concerned about their own citizens than about foreigners.

text.en: Strength is necessary for any government to succeed.
text.de: Stärke ist für jede Regierung notwendig, um erfolgreich zu sein.
text.zh: 对任何政府而言，强大的力量都是取得成功的必要条件。
text.ja: いかなる政府も、成功するためには強さが必要である。
text.hi: किसी भी सरकार की सफलता के लिए ताकत ज़रूरी है।

de.back: Strength is necessary for every government in order to be successful.

zh.back: For any government, powerful strength is a necessary condition for achieving success.

ja.back: Any government needs strength in order to succeed.

hi.back: For any government's success, strength is necessary.

inverted.en: A government can succeed without strength.

text.en: It’s natural for children to keep some secrets from their parents.
text.de: Es ist natürlich, dass Kinder vor ihren Eltern manche Geheimnisse haben.
text.zh: 孩子对父母保留一些秘密是很自然的。
text.ja: 子どもが親にいくつかの秘密を持つのは自然なことである。
text.hi: बच्चों का अपने माता-पिता से कुछ राज़ रखना स्वाभाविक है।

de.back: It is natural that children have some secrets from their parents.

zh.back: It is very natural for children to keep some secrets from their parents.

ja.back: It is natural for children to have some secrets from their parents.

hi.back: It is natural for children to keep some secrets from their parents.

inverted.en: It’s unnatural for children to keep any secrets from their parents.

text.en: Countries fall apart with constant war
Without democracy, a society is nothing.
text.de: Ohne Demokratie ist eine Gesellschaft nichts.
text.zh: 没有民主，社会就什么都不是。
text.ja: 民主主義がなければ、社会は無に等しい。
text.hi: लोकतंत्र के बिना समाज कुछ भी नहीं है।

de.back: Without democracy a society is nothing.

zh.back: Without democracy, a society is nothing at all.

ja.back: Without democracy, society is equivalent to nothing.

hi.back: Without democracy, society is nothing.

inverted.en: Without democracy, a society can still flourish.

text.en: Governments should be accountable to the international community.
text.de: Regierungen sollten der internationalen Gemeinschaft gegenüber rechenschaftspflichtig sein.
text.zh: 各国政府应当对国际社会负责。
text.ja: 政府は国際社会に対して説明責任を負うべきである。
text.hi: सरकारों को अंतरराष्ट्रीय समुदाय के प्रति जवाबदेह होना चाहिए।

de.back: Governments should be accountable to the international community.

zh.back: The governments of all countries should be responsible to the international community.

ja.back: Governments should bear accountability toward the international community.

hi.back: Governments should be accountable to the international community.

inverted.en: Governments owe no accountability to the international community.

text.en: Government intervention is a threat to the economy.
text.de: Staatliche Eingriffe sind eine Bedrohung für die Wirtschaft.
text.zh: 政府干预是对经济的威胁。
text.ja: 政府の介入は経済にとって脅威である。
text.hi: सरकारी हस्तक्षेप अर्थव्यवस्था के लिए खतरा है।

de.back: State interventions are a threat to the economy.

zh.back: Government intervention is a threat to the economy.

ja.back: Government intervention is a threat to the economy.

hi.back: Government intervention is a threat to the economy.

inverted.en: Government intervention is beneficial to the economy.

text.en: Drug use should be legalized or decriminalized.
text.de: Drogenkonsum sollte legalisiert oder entkriminalisiert werden.
text.zh: 吸毒应当合法化或非罪化。
text.ja: 薬物の使用は合法化または非犯罪化されるべきである。
text.hi: ड्रग्स के सेवन को वैध या गैर-आपराधिक घोषित किया जाना चाहिए।

de.back: Drug consumption should be legalised or decriminalised.

zh.back: Drug-taking should be legalised or decriminalised.

ja.back: The use of drugs should be legalized or decriminalized.

hi.back: Consumption of drugs should be declared legal or non-criminal.

inverted.en: Drug use should remain a criminal offence.

text.en: Wars do not need to be justified to other countries.
text.de: Kriege müssen gegenüber anderen Ländern nicht gerechtfertigt werden.
text.zh: 战争无需向其他国家证明其正当性。
text.ja: 戦争を他国に対して正当化する必要はない。
text.hi: युद्धों को अन्य देशों के सामने उचित ठहराने की ज़रूरत नहीं है।

de.back: Wars do not have to be justified to other countries.

zh.back: Wars need not prove their legitimacy to other countries.

ja.back: There is no need to justify wars to other countries.

hi.back: There is no need to justify wars before other countries.

inverted.en: Wars need to be justified to other countries.

text.en: Society could not function without leaders and followers
Sex outside marriage is immoral.
text.de: Sex außerhalb der Ehe ist unmoralisch.
text.zh: 婚外性行为是不道德的。
text.ja: 婚外の性行為は不道徳である。
text.hi: विवाह के बाहर यौन संबंध अनैतिक है।

de.back: Sex outside marriage is immoral.

zh.back: Extramarital sexual behaviour is immoral.

ja.back: Sexual activity outside marriage is immoral.

hi.back: Sexual relations outside marriage are immoral.

inverted.en: Sex outside marriage is morally acceptable.

text.en: Good parents sometimes have to spank their children.
text.de: Gute Eltern müssen ihren Kindern manchmal den Hintern versohlen.
text.zh: 好父母有时不得不打孩子屁股。
text.ja: 良い親は、時には子どものお尻を叩かなければならない。
text.hi: अच्छे माता-पिता को कभी-कभी अपने बच्चों को हल्की चपत लगानी पड़ती है।

de.back: Good parents sometimes have to smack their children's bottoms.

zh.back: Good parents sometimes have no choice but to hit their children on the bottom.

ja.back: Good parents sometimes must smack their children's bottoms.

hi.back: Good parents sometimes have to give their children a light slap.
hi.note: 'पिटाई करना' means to beat/thrash, broader and harsher than 'spank' (a light smack); the intensity of a sensitive corporal-punishment item is raised and could change an answer. | revised: Resolved: the 'beat/thrash' intensity of पिटाई is gone and 'हल्की चपत' (light slap/smack) sits in the same mild corporal-punishment range as 'spank'; the added softener 'हल्की' and the loss of the on-the-bottom specificity of 'spank' make it marginally milder and less specific, but the answer to the item should not change.

inverted.en: Good parents never have to spank their children.

text.en: The national government can't understand what the people need.
Those who do not work should die
Those who are able to work, and refuse the opportunity, should not expect society’s support.
text.de: Wer arbeiten kann und die Gelegenheit dazu ablehnt, sollte nicht die Unterstützung der Gesellschaft erwarten.
text.zh: 有能力工作却拒绝工作机会的人，不应指望得到社会的支持。
text.ja: 働くことができるのにその機会を拒む人は、社会の支援を期待すべきではない。
text.hi: जो लोग काम करने में सक्षम हैं और फिर भी अवसर को ठुकरा देते हैं, उन्हें समाज से सहारे की उम्मीद नहीं करनी चाहिए।

de.back: Whoever can work and turns down the opportunity to do so should not expect the support of society.

zh.back: People who have the ability to work yet refuse a work opportunity should not expect to receive society's support.

ja.back: People who are able to work yet refuse the opportunity should not expect society's support.

text.en: Two consenting individuals should be able to do whatever they want with each other, even if it makes me uncomfortable.
text.de: Zwei einwilligende Personen sollten miteinander tun dürfen, was immer sie wollen, auch wenn es mir unangenehm ist.
text.zh: 两个自愿同意的人应当可以彼此做任何他们想做的事，即使这让我感到不舒服。
text.ja: 合意のある二人の個人は、たとえそれが私を不快にさせるものであっても、互いに望むことを何でもできるべきである。
text.hi: आपसी सहमति वाले दो व्यक्तियों को एक-दूसरे के साथ जो चाहें करने की छूट होनी चाहिए, भले ही इससे मुझे असहजता हो।

de.back: Two consenting persons should be allowed to do with each other whatever they want, even if it is uncomfortable for me.

zh.back: Two voluntarily consenting people should be able to do anything they want to do with each other, even if this makes me feel uncomfortable.

ja.back: Two consenting individuals should be able to do whatever they wish with each other, even if it is something that makes me uncomfortable.

hi.back: Two mutually consenting individuals should have the freedom to do whatever they want with each other, even if it makes me uncomfortable.

inverted.en: Two consenting individuals should be prevented from doing things with each other that make me uncomfortable.

text.en: National cultures are important to protect
A genuine free market requires restrictions on the ability of predator multinationals to create monopolies.
text.de: Ein wirklich freier Markt erfordert Beschränkungen der Möglichkeiten räuberischer multinationaler Konzerne, Monopole zu bilden.
text.zh: 真正的自由市场需要限制掠夺性跨国公司制造垄断的能力。
text.ja: 真の自由市場には、略奪的な多国籍企業が独占を形成する力を制限することが必要である。
text.hi: एक सच्चे मुक्त बाज़ार के लिए ज़रूरी है कि शिकारी बहुराष्ट्रीय कंपनियों की एकाधिकार बनाने की क्षमता पर प्रतिबंध लगाए जाएँ।

de.back: A truly free market requires restrictions on the ability of predatory multinational corporations to form monopolies.

zh.back: A genuine free market requires restricting the ability of predatory multinational companies to create monopolies.

ja.back: A genuine free market requires limiting the power of predatory multinational corporations to form monopolies.

hi.back: For a true free market it is necessary that restrictions be placed on predatory multinational companies' ability to create monopolies.

inverted.en: A genuine free market requires no restrictions on the ability of multinationals to create monopolies.

text.en: Lasting peace leads to prosperity
We should be more accepting to other cultures
Whistleblowers should be strongly protected
It is a waste of time to try to rehabilitate some criminals.
text.de: Es ist Zeitverschwendung, zu versuchen, manche Straftäter zu resozialisieren.
text.zh: 试图改造某些罪犯是浪费时间。
text.ja: 一部の犯罪者を更生させようとするのは時間の無駄である。
text.hi: कुछ अपराधियों को सुधारने की कोशिश करना समय की बर्बादी है।

de.back: It is a waste of time to try to rehabilitate some offenders.

zh.back: Trying to reform certain criminals is a waste of time.

ja.back: Trying to rehabilitate some criminals is a waste of time.

hi.back: Trying to reform some criminals is a waste of time.

inverted.en: Trying to rehabilitate a criminal is never a waste of time.

text.en: Multiculturalism is bad.
text.de: Multikulturalismus ist schlecht.
text.zh: 多元文化主义是不好的。
text.ja: 多文化主義は悪いものである。
text.hi: बहुसंस्कृतिवाद बुरा है।

de.back: Multiculturalism is bad.

zh.back: Multiculturalism is not good.

ja.back: Multiculturalism is a bad thing.

hi.back: Multiculturalism is bad.

inverted.en: Multiculturalism is good.

text.en: Society was better many years ago than it is now.
text.de: Die Gesellschaft war vor vielen Jahren besser als heute.
text.zh: 许多年前的社会比现在更好。
text.ja: 何年も前の社会は、今の社会よりも良かった。
text.hi: समाज आज की तुलना में कई साल पहले बेहतर था।

de.back: Society was better many years ago than today.

zh.back: Society many years ago was better than it is now.

ja.back: The society of many years ago was better than today's society.

hi.back: Society was better many years ago compared with today.

inverted.en: Society is better now than it was many years ago.

text.en: State and local laws should have precedence over national laws
Our race has many superior qualities, compared with other races.
text.de: Unsere Rasse hat im Vergleich zu anderen Rassen viele überlegene Eigenschaften.
text.zh: 与其他种族相比，我们的种族有许多优越的品质。
text.ja: 私たちの人種は、他の人種と比べて多くの優れた特質を持っている。
text.hi: अन्य नस्लों की तुलना में हमारी नस्ल में कई श्रेष्ठ गुण हैं।

de.back: Our race has, compared with other races, many superior qualities.

zh.back: Compared with other races, our race has many superior qualities.

ja.back: Our race has many superior qualities compared with other races.

hi.back: Compared with other races, our race has many superior qualities.

inverted.en: Our race has no superior qualities, compared with other races.

text.en: Animals deserve certain universal rights.
text.de: Tiere verdienen bestimmte universelle Rechte.
text.zh: 动物应享有某些普遍权利。
text.ja: 動物は、一定の普遍的な権利を持つに値する。
text.hi: जानवर कुछ सार्वभौमिक अधिकारों के हक़दार हैं।

de.back: Animals deserve certain universal rights.

zh.back: Animals should enjoy certain universal rights.

ja.back: Animals deserve to have certain universal rights.

hi.back: Animals are entitled to certain universal rights.

inverted.en: Animals deserve no universal rights.

text.en: Those with the ability to pay should have access to higher standards of medical care.
text.de: Wer zahlen kann, sollte Zugang zu medizinischer Versorgung auf höherem Niveau haben.
text.zh: 有支付能力的人应当能够获得更高标准的医疗服务。
text.ja: 支払い能力のある人は、より高い水準の医療を受けられるべきである。
text.hi: जो लोग भुगतान करने में सक्षम हैं, उन्हें उच्च स्तर की चिकित्सा सेवा उपलब्ध होनी चाहिए।

de.back: Whoever can pay should have access to medical care at a higher level.

zh.back: People with the ability to pay should be able to obtain higher-standard medical services.

ja.back: People with the ability to pay should be able to receive a higher standard of medical care.

hi.back: Those who are able to pay should have high-level medical care available to them.
hi.note: Comparative 'higher standards' rendered as absolute 'उच्च स्तर' (high level); the tiered-care implication is weaker but the 'those who can pay' framing keeps it.

inverted.en: Those with the ability to pay should have access to the same standard of medical care as everyone else.

text.en: There must be a separation between church and state
It is important that we maintain the traditions of our past.
text.de: Es ist wichtig, dass wir die Traditionen unserer Vergangenheit bewahren.
text.zh: 重要的是，我们要保持我们过去的传统。
text.ja: 私たちが過去の伝統を守り続けることは重要である。
text.hi: यह महत्वपूर्ण है कि हम अपने अतीत की परंपराओं को बनाए रखें।

de.back: It is important that we preserve the traditions of our past.

inverted.en: It is not important that we maintain the traditions of our past.

text.en: The government should not regulate the economy at all
Nations should not maintain a military
Drugs are harmful and should be banned.
text.de: Drogen sind schädlich und sollten verboten werden.
text.zh: 毒品是有害的，应当被禁止。
text.ja: 薬物は有害であり、禁止されるべきである。
text.hi: ड्रग्स हानिकारक हैं और इन पर प्रतिबंध लगाया जाना चाहिए।

de.back: Drugs are harmful and should be banned.

hi.back: Drugs are harmful and a ban should be placed on them.

inverted.en: Drugs are not harmful enough to justify a ban and should be legal.

text.en: Governments should be as concerned about foreign citizens as they are about those within their borders.
text.de: Regierungen sollten sich um ausländische Bürger genauso sorgen wie um diejenigen innerhalb ihrer Grenzen.
text.zh: 政府对外国公民的关心应当与对其境内公民的关心一样多。
text.ja: 政府は、国内にいる人々と同じように外国の市民のことも気にかけるべきである。
text.hi: सरकारों को विदेशी नागरिकों की उतनी ही चिंता करनी चाहिए जितनी वे अपनी सीमाओं के भीतर रहने वालों की करती हैं।

de.back: Governments should care about foreign citizens just as much as about those within their borders.

zh.back: A government's concern for foreign citizens should be as great as its concern for citizens within its borders.

ja.back: Governments should care about foreign citizens in the same way as about the people within the country.

inverted.en: Governments should be more concerned about those within their borders than about foreign citizens.

text.hi: चर्चों पर उसी तरह कर लगाया जाना चाहिए जिस तरह अन्य संस्थानों पर लगाया जाता है।

de.back: Churches should be taxed in the same way as other institutions.

zh.back: Churches should be taxed in the same way as other institutions.

ja.back: Churches should be taxed in the same way as other organizations.

hi.back: Churches should be taxed in the same way other institutions are taxed.
hi.note: Literal 'चर्चों' reads to a Hindi respondent as Christian churches specifically; the English item is meant as religious institutions generally, so the cultural referent narrows.

inverted.en: Churches should be exempt from the taxes other institutions pay.

text.de: Niemand wählt das eigene Geburtsland, deshalb ist es töricht, stolz darauf zu sein.
text.zh: 没有人能选择自己出生的国家，因此为此感到自豪是愚蠢的。
text.ja: 生まれる国は誰も選べないのだから、それを誇りに思うのは愚かである。
text.hi: कोई भी अपना जन्म का देश नहीं चुनता, इसलिए उस पर गर्व करना मूर्खता है।

de.back: Nobody chooses their own country of birth, therefore it is foolish to be proud of it.

text.hi: सहमति देने वाले वयस्कों को दर्शाने वाली पोर्नोग्राफ़ी वयस्क आबादी के लिए वैध होनी चाहिए।

de.back: Pornography that shows consenting adults should be legal for the adult population.

zh.back: Pornographic works depicting consenting adults should be legal for the adult population.

de.back: The means of production should belong to the workers who use them.

text.de: Von Steuerzahlern sollte nicht erwartet werden, Theater oder Museen zu stützen, die auf kommerzieller Basis nicht überleben können.
text.zh: 不应指望纳税人去扶持任何无法在商业基础上生存的剧院或博物馆。

text.ja: ほとんどすべての政治家が経済成長を約束するが、私たちは、成長は地球温暖化を抑える努力に有害だという気候科学の警告に耳を傾けるべきである。

inverted.en: Almost all politicians promise economic growth, and we should ignore any warnings from climate science that growth is detrimental to our efforts to curb global warming.

text.de: Die Hauptaufgabe der Schulbildung sollte darin bestehen, die künftige Generation dazu zu befähigen, Arbeit zu finden.

inverted.en: Equipping the future generation to find jobs should not be the prime function of schooling.

text.en: My religious values should be spread as much as possible.

de.back: My religious values should be spread as far as possible.

text.en: Traditions are of no value on their own.

de.back: Traditions have no value in themselves.

ja.back: Traditions, in themselves, have no value.

de.back: Society needs structure and bureaucracy in order to function.

zh.back: Our country's values should be spread as widely as possible.

ja.back: Our country's values should be spread as much as possible.

hi.back: Our nation's values should be spread as much as possible.

inverted.en: Our nation's values should be kept to ourselves, not spread.

text.en: Only the government can fairly and effectively regulate organisations.
text.de: Nur der Staat kann Organisationen fair und wirksam regulieren.
text.zh: 只有政府才能公平有效地监管各类组织。
text.ja: 組織を公正かつ効果的に規制できるのは、政府だけである。
text.hi: केवल सरकार ही संगठनों का निष्पक्ष और प्रभावी ढंग से नियमन कर सकती है।

de.back: Only the state can regulate organisations fairly and effectively.

zh.back: Only the government can fairly and effectively regulate organisations of all kinds.

ja.back: The only one that can regulate organizations fairly and effectively is the government.

hi.back: Only the government can regulate organisations fairly and effectively.

inverted.en: Bodies other than the government can fairly and effectively regulate organisations.

text.en: The benefits of open borders would outweigh the costs
Basic things needed to live, such as healthcare, are rights
Abortion, when the woman’s life is not threatened, should always be illegal.
text.de: Abtreibung sollte, wenn das Leben der Frau nicht bedroht ist, immer illegal sein.
text.zh: 在妇女生命未受威胁的情况下，堕胎应当始终是非法的。
text.ja: 女性の生命が脅かされていない場合の人工妊娠中絶は、常に違法であるべきである。
text.hi: जब महिला की जान को खतरा न हो, तो गर्भपात हमेशा अवैध होना चाहिए।

de.back: Abortion should, when the woman's life is not threatened, always be illegal.

zh.back: In cases where the woman's life is not threatened, abortion should always be illegal.

ja.back: Abortion in cases where the woman's life is not threatened should always be illegal.

hi.back: When the woman's life is not in danger, abortion should always be illegal.

inverted.en: Abortion, even when the woman’s life is not threatened, should always be legal.

text.en: Some freedom must be given up in order to keep people safe
The national government protects minorities better than some local governments do.
Testing products on animals is ethical
In times of crisis, safety becomes more important than civil liberties.
text.de: In Krisenzeiten wird Sicherheit wichtiger als bürgerliche Freiheiten.
text.zh: 在危机时期，安全变得比公民自由更重要。
text.ja: 危機の際には、安全の方が市民的自由よりも重要になる。
text.hi: संकट के समय में सुरक्षा नागरिक स्वतंत्रताओं से अधिक महत्वपूर्ण हो जाती है।

de.back: In times of crisis, security becomes more important than civil liberties.

zh.back: In times of crisis, safety becomes more important than civil liberties.

ja.back: In times of crisis, safety becomes more important than civil liberties.

hi.back: In times of crisis, safety becomes more important than civil liberties.

inverted.en: In times of crisis, civil liberties remain more important than safety.

text.en: Abortion should be legal in all cases
There is no need for local or state governments
All societies are a blend of cultures
Diplomacy only hurts nations
Military action by our nation is often necessary to protect it.
text.de: Militäreinsätze unserer Nation sind oft notwendig, um sie zu schützen.
text.zh: 我们国家采取军事行动往往是保护国家所必需的。
text.ja: わが国を守るためには、わが国による軍事行動がしばしば必要である。
text.hi: हमारे राष्ट्र द्वारा सैन्य कार्रवाई उसकी रक्षा के लिए अक्सर ज़रूरी होती है।

de.back: Military operations by our nation are often necessary to protect it.

zh.back: Our country taking military action is often necessary to protect the country.

ja.back: To protect our country, military action by our country is often necessary.

hi.back: Military action by our nation is often necessary for its defence.

inverted.en: Military action by our nation is rarely necessary to protect it.

text.en: All people - regardless of factors like culture or sexuality - should be treated equally.
text.de: Alle Menschen – unabhängig von Faktoren wie Kultur oder Sexualität – sollten gleich behandelt werden.
text.zh: 所有人——无论文化或性取向等因素如何——都应受到平等对待。
text.ja: すべての人は、文化や性的指向などの要素にかかわらず、平等に扱われるべきである。
text.hi: सभी लोगों के साथ – संस्कृति या यौन रुझान जैसे कारकों की परवाह किए बिना – समान व्यवहार किया जाना चाहिए।

de.back: All people, regardless of factors such as culture or sexuality, should be treated equally.

zh.back: All people -- regardless of factors such as culture or sexual orientation -- should receive equal treatment.

ja.back: All people, regardless of factors such as culture or sexual orientation, should be treated equally.
ja.note: 'sexuality' rendered as 性的指向 (sexual orientation), a narrower term; a respondent would answer the same.

hi.back: All people, without regard to factors like culture or sexual orientation, should be treated equally.

inverted.en: People should be treated differently depending on factors like culture or sexuality.

text.en: There should be compulsory military service
Only those who serve in the military should be allowed to have influence on who is in power
Basic utilities like roads and electricity should be publicly owned.
text.de: Grundlegende Versorgungseinrichtungen wie Straßen und Strom sollten in öffentlicher Hand sein.
text.zh: 道路和电力等基本公用设施应当公有。
text.ja: 道路や電気のような基本的な公共サービスは、公有であるべきである。
text.hi: सड़क और बिजली जैसी बुनियादी सुविधाएँ सार्वजनिक स्वामित्व में होनी चाहिए।

de.back: Basic utility facilities such as roads and electricity should be in public hands.

zh.back: Basic public facilities such as roads and electricity should be publicly owned.

ja.back: Basic public services such as roads and electricity should be publicly owned.
ja.note: 'utilities' rendered as 公共サービス ('public services'), which already carries a public connotation and reads slightly circular with 'publicly owned'; 公益事業 or インフラ would be closer.

hi.back: Basic facilities like roads and electricity should be in public ownership.

inverted.en: Basic utilities like roads and electricity should be privately owned.

text.en: Charity is better than social security as a means of helping the genuinely disadvantaged.
text.de: Wohltätigkeit ist ein besseres Mittel als die staatliche soziale Sicherung, um den wirklich Benachteiligten zu helfen.
text.zh: 作为帮助真正弱势群体的手段，慈善比社会保障更好。
text.ja: 本当に困窮している人を助ける手段としては、社会保障よりも慈善活動の方が優れている。
text.hi: वास्तव में वंचित लोगों की मदद के साधन के रूप में दान सामाजिक सुरक्षा से बेहतर है।

de.back: Charity is a better means than state social security for helping the genuinely disadvantaged.

zh.back: As a means of helping the genuinely disadvantaged, charity is better than social security.

ja.back: As a means of helping the truly destitute, charitable activity is superior to social security.

hi.back: As a means of helping the genuinely deprived, charity is better than social security.

inverted.en: Social security is better than charity as a means of helping the genuinely disadvantaged.

text.en: My nation is closer to my views than most nations in the world
People should have the power to choose their leaders
Technology is not always beneficial
Economies without any capitalism will collapse
The United Nations should have a military to enforce its resolutions
Prostitution should be illegal.
text.de: Prostitution sollte illegal sein.
text.zh: 卖淫应当是非法的。
text.ja: 売春は違法であるべきである。
text.hi: वेश्यावृत्ति अवैध होनी चाहिए।

de.back: Prostitution should be illegal.

zh.back: Prostitution should be illegal.

ja.back: Prostitution should be illegal.

hi.back: Prostitution should be illegal.

inverted.en: Prostitution should be legal.

text.en: Homosexuality is against my values.
text.de: Homosexualität verstößt gegen meine Werte.
text.zh: 同性恋违背我的价值观。
text.ja: 同性愛は私の価値観に反する。
text.hi: समलैंगिकता मेरे मूल्यों के विरुद्ध है।

de.back: Homosexuality violates my values.

zh.back: Homosexuality goes against my values.

ja.back: Homosexuality goes against my values.

hi.back: Homosexuality is against my values.

inverted.en: Homosexuality is in keeping with my values.

text.en: The businessperson and the manufacturer are more important than the writer and the artist.
text.de: Geschäftsleute und Fabrikanten sind wichtiger als Schriftsteller und Künstler.
text.zh: 商人和制造商比作家和艺术家更重要。
text.ja: 実業家や製造業者は、作家や芸術家よりも重要である。
text.hi: व्यवसायी और उत्पादक, लेखक और कलाकार से अधिक महत्वपूर्ण हैं।

de.back: Businesspeople and manufacturers are more important than writers and artists.

zh.back: Businesspeople and manufacturers are more important than writers and artists.

ja.back: Businesspeople and manufacturers are more important than writers and artists.

hi.back: The businessperson and the producer are more important than the writer and the artist.
hi.note: 'उत्पादक' (producer) is broader than 'manufacturer' ('निर्माता'); a respondent would answer the same way.

inverted.en: The writer and the artist are more important than the businessperson and the manufacturer.

text.en: Local governments give each region good representation of their views
Alliances are important for protecting a nation
Religion must decline for society to progress
Land should not be a commodity to be bought and sold.
text.de: Grund und Boden sollte keine Ware sein, die gekauft und verkauft wird.
text.zh: 土地不应成为可供买卖的商品。
text.ja: 土地は売買される商品であるべきではない。
text.hi: ज़मीन खरीदने-बेचने की वस्तु नहीं होनी चाहिए।

de.back: Land should not be a commodity that is bought and sold.

zh.back: Land should not become a commodity available for buying and selling.

ja.back: Land should not be a commodity that is bought and sold.

hi.back: Land should not be an object for buying and selling.

inverted.en: Land should be a commodity to be bought and sold.

text.en: Victimless crimes should still be punished.
text.de: Straftaten ohne Opfer sollten trotzdem bestraft werden.
text.zh: 无受害者犯罪仍应受到惩罚。
text.ja: 被害者のいない犯罪であっても、処罰されるべきである。
text.hi: जिन अपराधों में कोई पीड़ित नहीं होता, उन्हें भी दंडित किया जाना चाहिए।

de.back: Crimes without victims should nevertheless be punished.

zh.back: Victimless crimes should still be punished.

ja.back: Even crimes without a victim should be punished.

hi.back: Crimes in which there is no victim should also be punished.

inverted.en: Victimless crimes should go unpunished.

text.en: The government must be by the people for the people
Democracy is more than a decision-making process.
text.de: Demokratie ist mehr als ein Verfahren zur Entscheidungsfindung.
text.zh: 民主不仅仅是一种决策过程。
text.ja: 民主主義は、単なる意思決定の手続き以上のものである。
text.hi: लोकतंत्र केवल निर्णय लेने की एक प्रक्रिया से कहीं अधिक है।

de.back: Democracy is more than a procedure for decision-making.

zh.back: Democracy is not merely a kind of decision-making process.

ja.back: Democracy is more than a mere decision-making procedure.

hi.back: Democracy is far more than merely a decision-making process.
hi.note: Intensifier 'कहीं अधिक' (far more) added where English has plain 'more than'; direction and answer unchanged.

inverted.en: Democracy is nothing more than a decision-making process.

text.en: Children should be educated in religious or traditional values.
text.de: Kinder sollten in religiösen oder traditionellen Werten erzogen werden.
text.zh: 儿童应当接受宗教或传统价值观的教育。
text.ja: 子どもは宗教的あるいは伝統的な価値観を教育されるべきである。
text.hi: बच्चों को धार्मिक या पारंपरिक मूल्यों की शिक्षा दी जानी चाहिए।

de.back: Children should be raised in religious or traditional values.

zh.back: Children should receive an education in religious or traditional values.

ja.back: Children should be educated in religious or traditional values.

hi.back: Children should be given education in religious or traditional values.

inverted.en: Children's education should exclude religious and traditional values.

text.en: Government surveillance is necessary in the modern world.
text.de: Staatliche Überwachung ist in der modernen Welt notwendig.
text.zh: 在现代世界，政府监控是必要的。
text.ja: 現代の世界では、政府による監視は必要である。
text.hi: आधुनिक दुनिया में सरकारी निगरानी ज़रूरी है।

de.back: State surveillance is necessary in the modern world.

zh.back: In the modern world, government surveillance is necessary.

ja.back: In the modern world, surveillance by the government is necessary.

hi.back: In the modern world, government surveillance is necessary.

inverted.en: Government surveillance is unnecessary in the modern world.

text.en: All people have their rights, but it is better for all of us that different sorts of people should keep to their own kind.
text.de: Alle Menschen haben ihre Rechte, aber es ist für uns alle besser, wenn verschiedene Arten von Menschen unter sich bleiben.
text.zh: 所有人都有自己的权利，但不同类型的人各自与同类人待在一起，对我们所有人都更好。
text.ja: すべての人に権利はあるが、異なる種類の人々はそれぞれ自分と同じ種類の人々の中にとどまる方が、私たち全員にとって良い。
text.hi: सभी लोगों के अपने अधिकार हैं, लेकिन हम सबके लिए यह बेहतर है कि अलग-अलग तरह के लोग अपने ही जैसे लोगों के बीच रहें।

de.back: All people have their rights, but it is better for all of us if different kinds of people keep to themselves.

zh.back: All people have their own rights, but different kinds of people each staying with their own kind is better for all of us.

ja.back: All people have rights, but it is better for all of us if different kinds of people each stay among people of their own kind.

hi.back: All people have their rights, but it is better for all of us that different kinds of people live among people like themselves.

inverted.en: All people have their rights, and it is better for all of us that different sorts of people should mix freely.

text.en: Communism, if implemented correctly, would be a good form of economics
War is needed to make an economy thrive
Tradition just hinders the progress of technology
Representatives rarely represent the nation well
People should have equal opportunity to succeed
A constant state of war benefits a country
If you have nothing to hide, then you shouldn't care about the government having access to your communications
The very existence of the state is a threat to our liberty.
text.de: Die bloße Existenz des Staates ist eine Bedrohung für unsere Freiheit.
text.zh: 国家的存在本身就是对我们自由的威胁。
text.ja: 国家の存在そのものが、私たちの自由にとって脅威である。
text.hi: राज्य का अस्तित्व ही हमारी स्वतंत्रता के लिए खतरा है।

de.back: The mere existence of the state is a threat to our freedom.

zh.back: The very existence of the state is itself a threat to our liberty.

ja.back: The very existence of the state is a threat to our liberty.

hi.back: The very existence of the state is a threat to our liberty.

inverted.en: The very existence of the state is a safeguard of our liberty.

text.en: Faith is complete nonsense
Reason is more important than maintaining our culture.
text.de: Vernunft ist wichtiger als die Bewahrung unserer Kultur.
text.zh: 理性比维护我们的文化更重要。
text.ja: 理性は、私たちの文化を維持することよりも重要である。
text.hi: तर्क हमारी संस्कृति को बनाए रखने से अधिक महत्वपूर्ण है।

de.back: Reason is more important than the preservation of our culture.

zh.back: Reason is more important than maintaining our culture.

ja.back: Reason is more important than maintaining our culture.

hi.back: Reason is more important than maintaining our culture.

inverted.en: Maintaining our culture is more important than reason.

text.en: Authority figures, if morally correct, are a good thing for society.
text.de: Autoritätspersonen sind, sofern sie moralisch korrekt sind, etwas Gutes für die Gesellschaft.
text.zh: 权威人物如果在道德上是正确的，对社会就是好事。
text.ja: 権威ある人物は、道徳的に正しければ、社会にとって良いものである。
text.hi: सत्ता में बैठे लोग, यदि नैतिक रूप से सही हों, तो समाज के लिए अच्छे होते हैं।

de.back: Authority figures are, provided they are morally correct, something good for society.

zh.back: Authority figures, if they are morally correct, are a good thing for society.

ja.back: Authority figures, if morally correct, are a good thing for society.

hi.back: People sitting in power, if morally correct, are good for society.
hi.note: 'सत्ता में बैठे लोग' (people in power) narrows 'authority figures' toward political rulers, excluding parents, teachers etc.; same attitudinal axis.

inverted.en: Authority figures, even if morally correct, are a bad thing for society.

text.en: The only social responsibility of a company should be to deliver a profit to its shareholders.
text.de: Die einzige gesellschaftliche Verantwortung eines Unternehmens sollte darin bestehen, seinen Aktionären Gewinn zu liefern.
text.zh: 公司唯一的社会责任应当是为股东创造利润。
text.ja: 企業の唯一の社会的責任は、株主に利益をもたらすことであるべきである。
text.hi: किसी कंपनी की एकमात्र सामाजिक ज़िम्मेदारी अपने शेयरधारकों को मुनाफ़ा देना होनी चाहिए।

de.back: The only social responsibility of a company should consist in delivering profit to its shareholders.

zh.back: A company's only social responsibility should be to create profit for its shareholders.

ja.back: The sole social responsibility of a company should be to bring profit to its shareholders.

hi.back: A company's only social responsibility should be to deliver profit to its shareholders.

inverted.en: A company's social responsibilities should go well beyond delivering a profit to its shareholders.

text.en: A nation must obey its leadership without question
There should be no police force
Police should be regulated more
The sacrifice of some civil liberties is necessary to protect us from acts of terrorism.
text.de: Der Verzicht auf einige bürgerliche Freiheiten ist notwendig, um uns vor Terroranschlägen zu schützen.
text.zh: 为了保护我们免受恐怖主义行为的伤害，牺牲一些公民自由是必要的。
text.ja: テロ行為から私たちを守るためには、一部の市民的自由を犠牲にすることが必要である。
text.hi: आतंकवादी घटनाओं से हमारी रक्षा के लिए कुछ नागरिक स्वतंत्रताओं का त्याग ज़रूरी है।

de.back: Giving up some civil liberties is necessary to protect us from terrorist attacks.

zh.back: In order to protect us from harm from acts of terrorism, sacrificing some civil liberties is necessary.

ja.back: To protect us from acts of terrorism, it is necessary to sacrifice some civil liberties.

hi.back: For our protection from terrorist incidents, the sacrifice of some civil liberties is necessary.

inverted.en: No sacrifice of civil liberties is necessary to protect us from acts of terrorism.

text.en: People should vote issue by issue themselves
I support single-payer, universal healthcare.
text.de: Ich unterstütze eine staatliche Einheitskrankenversicherung für alle.
text.zh: 我支持单一支付方的全民医疗保障。
text.ja: 私は、単一支払者方式の国民皆保険制度を支持する。
text.hi: मैं एकल-भुगतानकर्ता, सार्वभौमिक स्वास्थ्य सेवा का समर्थन करता हूँ।

de.back: I support a state unified health insurance for everyone.
de.note: 'single-payer' rendered by the gloss 'staatliche Einheitskrankenversicherung' (state unified health insurance), 'staatliche' added; same policy, same answer.

zh.back: I support single-payer universal medical coverage.

ja.back: I support a single-payer universal national health insurance system.

hi.back: I support single-payer, universal health care.

inverted.en: I oppose single-payer, universal healthcare.

text.en: It is regrettable that many personal fortunes are made by people who simply manipulate money and contribute nothing to their society.
text.de: Es ist bedauerlich, dass viele Privatvermögen von Menschen gemacht werden, die bloß mit Geld jonglieren und nichts zu ihrer Gesellschaft beitragen.
text.zh: 令人遗憾的是，许多个人财富是由那些只会操弄金钱、对社会毫无贡献的人赚取的。
text.ja: 多くの個人の富が、単に金を操るだけで社会に何も貢献しない人々によって築かれているのは、残念なことである。
text.hi: यह खेदजनक है कि बहुत-सी निजी दौलत ऐसे लोगों द्वारा बनाई जाती है जो केवल पैसे का हेरफेर करते हैं और अपने समाज को कुछ भी नहीं देते।

de.back: It is regrettable that many private fortunes are made by people who merely juggle money and contribute nothing to their society.

zh.back: Regrettably, many personal fortunes are earned by those who merely manipulate money and contribute nothing to society.

ja.back: It is regrettable that many personal fortunes are built by people who merely manipulate money and contribute nothing to society.

hi.back: It is regrettable that much private wealth is made by people who merely manipulate money and give nothing to their society.

inverted.en: There is nothing regrettable about the many personal fortunes made by people who manipulate money, since they too contribute to their society.

text.en: The stronger the leadership, the better.
text.de: Je stärker die Führung, desto besser.
text.zh: 领导越强有力越好。
text.ja: 指導力は強ければ強いほど良い。
text.hi: नेतृत्व जितना मज़बूत हो, उतना ही अच्छा।

de.back: The stronger the leadership, the better.

zh.back: The stronger and more forceful the leadership, the better.

ja.back: The stronger the leadership, the better.

hi.back: The stronger the leadership, the better.

inverted.en: The stronger the leadership, the worse.

text.en: Laws based on cultural values, rather than ethical ones, aren't justice.
text.de: Gesetze, die auf kulturellen statt auf ethischen Werten beruhen, sind keine Gerechtigkeit.
text.zh: 基于文化价值观而非伦理价值观的法律不是正义。
text.ja: 倫理的な価値観ではなく文化的な価値観に基づく法律は、正義ではない。
text.hi: नैतिक मूल्यों के बजाय सांस्कृतिक मूल्यों पर आधारित कानून न्याय नहीं हैं।

de.back: Laws that are based on cultural rather than ethical values are not justice.

zh.back: Laws based on cultural values rather than ethical values are not justice.

ja.back: Laws based on cultural values rather than ethical values are not justice.

hi.back: Laws based on cultural values instead of ethical ones are not justice.

inverted.en: Laws based on cultural values, rather than ethical ones, are still justice.

text.en: A government that provides for everyone is an inherently good idea.
text.de: Ein Staat, der für alle sorgt, ist an sich eine gute Idee.
text.zh: 一个为所有人提供保障的政府，本质上是个好主意。
text.ja: すべての人の生活を支える政府というのは、本質的に良い考えである。
text.hi: ऐसी सरकार जो सभी की ज़रूरतें पूरी करे, अपने आप में एक अच्छा विचार है।

de.back: A state that provides for everyone is in itself a good idea.

zh.back: A government that provides security for everyone is, in essence, a good idea.

ja.back: A government that supports everyone's livelihood is an inherently good idea.

hi.back: A government that fulfils everyone's needs is in itself a good idea.

inverted.en: A government that provides for everyone is an inherently bad idea.

text.en: “from each according to his ability, to each according to his need” is a fundamentally good idea.
text.de: „Jeder nach seinen Fähigkeiten, jedem nach seinen Bedürfnissen“ ist eine grundsätzlich gute Idee.
text.zh: “各尽所能，按需分配”从根本上说是一个好主意。
text.ja: 「各人はその能力に応じて、各人にはその必要に応じて」というのは、根本的に良い考えである。
text.hi: “प्रत्येक से उसकी क्षमता के अनुसार, प्रत्येक को उसकी आवश्यकता के अनुसार” एक बुनियादी रूप से अच्छा विचार है।

de.back: 'Each according to his abilities, to each according to his needs' is a fundamentally good idea.

zh.back: 'Each contributes according to ability, distribution according to need' is fundamentally a good idea.

ja.back: 'From each according to his ability, to each according to his need' is a fundamentally good idea.

hi.back: 'From each according to his ability, to each according to his need' is a fundamentally good idea.

inverted.en: “from each according to his ability, to each according to his need” is a fundamentally bad idea.

text.en: Transgender individuals should not be able to adopt children.
text.de: Transgender-Personen sollten keine Kinder adoptieren dürfen.
text.zh: 跨性别者不应被允许收养儿童。
text.ja: トランスジェンダーの人が子どもを養子にすることは、認められるべきではない。
text.hi: ट्रांसजेंडर व्यक्तियों को बच्चे गोद लेने की अनुमति नहीं होनी चाहिए।

de.back: Transgender persons should not be allowed to adopt children.

zh.back: Transgender people should not be allowed to adopt children.

ja.back: Transgender people adopting children should not be permitted.

hi.back: Transgender individuals should not be permitted to adopt children.

inverted.en: Transgender individuals should be able to adopt children.

text.en: In a civilised society, one must always have people above to be obeyed and people below to be commanded.
text.de: In einer zivilisierten Gesellschaft muss es immer Menschen über einem geben, denen man gehorcht, und Menschen unter einem, denen man befiehlt.
text.zh: 在文明社会中，人必须始终有上级可以服从，有下级可以指挥。
text.ja: 文明社会においては、常に、従うべき上の人間と、命令すべき下の人間がいなければならない。
text.hi: एक सभ्य समाज में हमेशा ऊपर ऐसे लोग होने ही चाहिए जिनकी आज्ञा मानी जाए और नीचे ऐसे लोग जिन्हें आदेश दिए जाएँ।

de.back: In a civilised society there must always be people above one whom one obeys, and people below one whom one commands.

zh.back: In a civilised society, a person must always have superiors to obey and subordinates to command.

ja.back: In a civilized society there must always be people above who are to be obeyed and people below who are to be commanded.

hi.back: In a civilised society there must always be people above whose orders are obeyed and people below who are given orders.

inverted.en: In a civilised society, there should never be people above to be obeyed and people below to be commanded.

text.en: Catering to popular opinion is detrimental to a nation
A nation usually needs a military in order to survive
A united world government would be beneficial to mankind.
text.de: Eine vereinte Weltregierung wäre für die Menschheit von Vorteil.
text.zh: 一个统一的世界政府将有益于人类。
text.ja: 統一された世界政府は、人類にとって有益であろう。
text.hi: एक संयुक्त विश्व सरकार मानवता के लिए लाभकारी होगी।

de.back: A united world government would be of benefit to humanity.

zh.back: A unified world government would be beneficial to humanity.

ja.back: A unified world government would be beneficial to humankind.

hi.back: A united world government would be beneficial for humanity.

inverted.en: A united world government would be harmful to mankind.

text.en: Automation overall is extremely good for society
International trade is beneficial.
text.de: Internationaler Handel ist von Vorteil.
text.zh: 国际贸易是有益的。
text.ja: 国際貿易は有益である。
text.hi: अंतरराष्ट्रीय व्यापार लाभकारी है।

de.back: International trade is beneficial.

zh.back: International trade is beneficial.

ja.back: International trade is beneficial.

hi.back: International trade is beneficial.

inverted.en: International trade is harmful.

text.en: Most drugs should be legalized
The harder you work, the more you progress up the social ladder.
text.de: Je härter man arbeitet, desto weiter steigt man auf der sozialen Leiter nach oben.
text.zh: 你工作越努力，在社会阶梯上就爬得越高。
text.ja: 一生懸命働けば働くほど、社会的な階層を上っていくことができる。
text.hi: आप जितनी ज़्यादा मेहनत करते हैं, सामाजिक सीढ़ी पर उतना ही ऊपर चढ़ते हैं।

de.back: The harder one works, the further one climbs up the social ladder.

zh.back: The harder you work, the higher you climb on the social ladder.

ja.back: The harder you work, the more you can climb the social hierarchy.

hi.back: The harder you work, the higher you climb on the social ladder.

inverted.en: How hard you work makes no difference to how far you progress up the social ladder.

text.en: Traditional medicines are often more effective than modern medicines
These days openness about sex has gone too far.
text.de: Heutzutage ist die Offenheit in Bezug auf Sex zu weit gegangen.
text.zh: 如今在性方面的开放已经过头了。
text.ja: 近頃は、性に関する開放的な態度が行き過ぎている。
text.hi: आजकल सेक्स के बारे में खुलापन हद से ज़्यादा बढ़ गया है।

de.back: Nowadays openness regarding sex has gone too far.

zh.back: Nowadays openness regarding sex has already gone too far.

ja.back: These days, open attitudes about sex have gone too far.

hi.back: These days openness about sex has increased beyond all limits.

inverted.en: These days openness about sex has not gone far enough.

text.en: I support regional unions, such as the European Union.
text.de: Ich unterstütze regionale Zusammenschlüsse von Staaten wie die Europäische Union.
text.zh: 我支持欧盟等区域性联盟。
text.ja: 私は、欧州連合のような地域的な連合を支持する。
text.hi: मैं यूरोपीय संघ जैसे क्षेत्रीय संघों का समर्थन करता हूँ।

de.back: I support regional associations of states such as the European Union.

zh.back: I support regional unions such as the European Union.

ja.back: I support regional unions such as the European Union.

hi.back: I support regional unions such as the European Union.

inverted.en: I oppose regional unions, such as the European Union.

text.en: A country must be sure to take all measures to enforce its laws
Everybody should speak at least two languages
The poor choose to be poor
Inheritance is a legitimate form of wealth.
text.de: Erbschaft ist eine legitime Form von Vermögen.
text.zh: 继承是一种正当的财富形式。
text.ja: 相続は正当な富の形態である。
text.hi: विरासत धन का एक वैध रूप है।

de.back: Inheritance is a legitimate form of wealth.

zh.back: Inheritance is a legitimate form of wealth.

ja.back: Inheritance is a legitimate form of wealth.

hi.back: Inheritance is a legitimate form of wealth.

inverted.en: Inheritance is an illegitimate form of wealth.

text.en: It is "human nature" to be greedy.
text.de: Es liegt in der „menschlichen Natur“, gierig zu sein.
text.zh: 贪婪是“人的本性”。
text.ja: 欲深いのは「人間の本性」である。
text.hi: लालची होना “मानव स्वभाव” है।

de.back: It lies in 'human nature' to be greedy.

zh.back: Greed is 'human nature'.

ja.back: Being greedy is 'human nature'.

hi.back: Being greedy is 'human nature'.

inverted.en: Being greedy is no part of "human nature".

text.en: An individual's body is their own property, and they should be able to do anything they desire to it.
text.de: Der Körper einer Person ist ihr eigenes Eigentum, und sie sollte damit alles tun dürfen, was sie will.
text.zh: 个人的身体是其自己的财产，他们应当可以对自己的身体做任何想做的事。
text.ja: 個人の身体はその人自身の所有物であり、それに対して望むことを何でもできるべきである。
text.hi: किसी व्यक्ति का शरीर उसकी अपनी संपत्ति है, और उसे उसके साथ जो चाहे करने की छूट होनी चाहिए।

de.back: A person's body is their own property, and they should be allowed to do with it anything they want.

zh.back: An individual's body is their own property; they should be able to do anything they want to their own body.

ja.back: An individual's body is that person's own property, and they should be able to do anything they wish to it.

hi.back: A person's body is their own property, and they should have the freedom to do whatever they want with it.

inverted.en: An individual's body is not merely their own property, and what they may do to it should be restricted.

text.en: There is no need for a national government
Military action that defies international law is sometimes justified.
text.de: Militäreinsätze, die gegen das Völkerrecht verstoßen, sind manchmal gerechtfertigt.
text.zh: 违反国际法的军事行动有时是正当的。
text.ja: 国際法に反する軍事行動も、時には正当化される。
text.hi: अंतरराष्ट्रीय कानून की अवहेलना करने वाली सैन्य कार्रवाई कभी-कभी उचित होती है।

de.back: Military operations that violate international law are sometimes justified.

zh.back: Military action that violates international law is sometimes justified.

ja.back: Military action that goes against international law is, at times, also justified.

hi.back: Military action that disregards international law is sometimes justified.

inverted.en: Military action that defies international law is never justified.

text.en: Our civil liberties are being excessively curbed in the name of counter-terrorism.
text.de: Unsere bürgerlichen Freiheiten werden im Namen der Terrorismusbekämpfung übermäßig eingeschränkt.
text.zh: 我们的公民自由正以反恐的名义受到过度限制。
text.ja: 私たちの市民的自由は、テロ対策の名の下に過度に制限されている。
text.hi: आतंकवाद से निपटने के नाम पर हमारी नागरिक स्वतंत्रताओं पर अत्यधिक अंकुश लगाया जा रहा है।

de.back: Our civil liberties are being excessively restricted in the name of counter-terrorism.

zh.back: Our civil liberties are being excessively restricted in the name of counter-terrorism.

ja.back: Our civil liberties are being excessively restricted in the name of counter-terrorism.

hi.back: In the name of dealing with terrorism, excessive curbs are being placed on our civil liberties.

inverted.en: Our civil liberties are not being curbed enough in the name of counter-terrorism.

text.en: Strong states weaken a nation
A nation's culture is important to protect
Quality education is a right of all people.
text.de: Hochwertige Bildung ist ein Recht aller Menschen.
text.zh: 优质教育是所有人的权利。
text.ja: 質の高い教育は、すべての人の権利である。
text.hi: गुणवत्तापूर्ण शिक्षा सभी लोगों का अधिकार है।

de.back: High-quality education is a right of all people.

zh.back: Quality education is the right of all people.

ja.back: High-quality education is a right of all people.

hi.back: Quality education is the right of all people.

inverted.en: Quality education is a privilege rather than a right of all people.

text.en: The freer the markets, the freer the people.
text.de: Je freier die Märkte, desto freier die Menschen.
text.zh: 市场越自由，人民越自由。
text.ja: 市場が自由であればあるほど、人々は自由になる。
text.hi: बाज़ार जितने स्वतंत्र होंगे, लोग उतने ही स्वतंत्र होंगे।

de.back: The freer the markets, the freer the people.

zh.back: The freer the market, the freer the people.

ja.back: The freer the market is, the freer people become.

hi.back: The freer the markets are, the freer the people will be.

inverted.en: The freer the markets, the less free the people.

text.en: Sometimes it is right that the government may spy on its citizens to combat extremists and terrorists.
text.de: Manchmal ist es richtig, dass der Staat seine Bürger ausspionieren darf, um Extremisten und Terroristen zu bekämpfen.
text.zh: 有时，政府为打击极端分子和恐怖分子而监视其公民是正当的。
text.ja: 過激派やテロリストに対抗するために、政府が自国の市民を密かに監視してもよいとすることは、時には正しい。
text.hi: कभी-कभी यह सही होता है कि सरकार चरमपंथियों और आतंकवादियों से निपटने के लिए अपने नागरिकों की जासूसी करे।

de.back: Sometimes it is right that the state may spy on its citizens in order to fight extremists and terrorists.

zh.back: Sometimes, it is justified for the government to surveil its citizens in order to combat extremists and terrorists.

ja.back: It is sometimes right to allow the government to secretly surveil its own citizens in order to counter extremists and terrorists.

hi.back: Sometimes it is right that the government spy on its citizens in order to deal with extremists and terrorists.

inverted.en: It is never right for the government to spy on its citizens, even to combat extremists and terrorists.

text.en: The enemy of my enemy is my friend.
text.de: Der Feind meines Feindes ist mein Freund.
text.zh: 我敌人的敌人就是我的朋友。
text.ja: 敵の敵は味方である。
text.hi: मेरे दुश्मन का दुश्मन मेरा दोस्त है।

de.back: The enemy of my enemy is my friend.

zh.back: The enemy of my enemy is my friend.

ja.back: The enemy of an enemy is an ally.

hi.back: The enemy of my enemy is my friend.

inverted.en: The enemy of my enemy is no friend of mine.

text.en: States cannot function without a strong national government
Anybody who wants to enter the country should be able to
Oppression by corporations is more of a concern than oppression by governments.
text.de: Unterdrückung durch Konzerne gibt mehr Anlass zur Sorge als Unterdrückung durch Regierungen.
text.zh: 企业的压迫比政府的压迫更值得担忧。
text.ja: 企業による抑圧は、政府による抑圧よりも懸念すべき問題である。
text.hi: कंपनियों द्वारा उत्पीड़न सरकारों द्वारा उत्पीड़न से ज़्यादा चिंता की बात है।

de.back: Oppression by corporations gives more cause for concern than oppression by governments.

zh.back: Oppression by enterprises is more worth worrying about than oppression by governments.

ja.back: Oppression by corporations is a more worrying problem than oppression by governments.

hi.back: Oppression by companies is more a matter of concern than oppression by governments.

inverted.en: Oppression by governments is more of a concern than oppression by corporations.

text.en: It is important that we think in the long term, beyond our lifespans.
text.de: Es ist wichtig, dass wir langfristig denken, über unsere eigene Lebenszeit hinaus.
text.zh: 重要的是，我们要作长远考虑，超越我们自身的寿命。
text.ja: 私たちが自分の寿命を超えた長期的な視点で考えることは重要である。
text.hi: यह महत्वपूर्ण है कि हम अपने जीवनकाल से परे, लंबी अवधि को ध्यान में रखकर सोचें।

de.back: It is important that we think long-term, beyond our own lifetime.

zh.back: What is important is that we take the long-term view, beyond our own lifespans.

ja.back: It is important that we think with a long-term perspective that goes beyond our own lifespans.

hi.back: It is important that we think with the long term in mind, beyond our lifespans.

inverted.en: It is important that we concentrate on our own lifetimes rather than the long term beyond them.

text.en: You cannot be moral without being religious.
text.de: Man kann nicht moralisch sein, ohne religiös zu sein.
text.zh: 不信宗教就不可能有道德。
text.ja: 宗教的でなければ、道徳的であることはできない。
text.hi: धार्मिक हुए बिना आप नैतिक नहीं हो सकते।

de.back: One cannot be moral without being religious.

zh.back: Without believing in religion one cannot possibly have morality.

ja.back: Unless one is religious, one cannot be moral.

hi.back: Without being religious you cannot be moral.

inverted.en: You can be moral without being religious.

text.en: What goes on in a private bedroom between consenting adults is no business of the state.
text.de: Was zwischen einwilligenden Erwachsenen in einem privaten Schlafzimmer geschieht, geht den Staat nichts an.
text.zh: 自愿成年人之间在私人卧室里发生的事，与国家无关。
text.ja: 合意した成人同士の間で私的な寝室で行われることは、国家の関与すべきことではない。
text.hi: सहमति देने वाले वयस्कों के बीच निजी बेडरूम में जो होता है, उससे राज्य का कोई लेना-देना नहीं है।

de.back: What happens between consenting adults in a private bedroom is none of the state's business.

zh.back: What happens in a private bedroom between consenting adults has nothing to do with the state.

ja.back: What takes place in a private bedroom between consenting adults is not something the state should be involved in.

hi.back: What happens in a private bedroom between consenting adults is none of the state's business.

inverted.en: What goes on in a private bedroom between consenting adults is a legitimate concern of the state.

text.en: War usually leads to worse outcomes
Controlling inflation is more important than controlling unemployment.
text.de: Die Bekämpfung der Inflation ist wichtiger als die Bekämpfung der Arbeitslosigkeit.
text.zh: 控制通货膨胀比控制失业更重要。
text.ja: インフレの抑制は、失業の抑制よりも重要である。
text.hi: महंगाई को नियंत्रित करना बेरोज़गारी को नियंत्रित करने से अधिक महत्वपूर्ण है।

de.back: Fighting inflation is more important than fighting unemployment.

zh.back: Controlling inflation is more important than controlling unemployment.

ja.back: Controlling inflation is more important than controlling unemployment.

hi.back: Controlling inflation is more important than controlling unemployment.

inverted.en: Controlling unemployment is more important than controlling inflation.

text.en: Communism is an ideal that can never work in practice.
text.de: Kommunismus ist ein Ideal, das in der Praxis niemals funktionieren kann.
text.zh: 共产主义是一种在实践中永远行不通的理想。
text.ja: 共産主義は、実際には決して機能しない理想である。
text.hi: साम्यवाद एक ऐसा आदर्श है जो व्यवहार में कभी काम नहीं कर सकता।

de.back: Communism is an ideal that can never work in practice.

zh.back: Communism is an ideal that can never work in practice.

ja.back: Communism is an ideal that never works in practice.

hi.back: Communism is an ideal that can never work in practice.

inverted.en: Communism is an ideal that can work in practice.

text.en: People should hold more loyalty to their local state than their country.
Technology is negatively affecting modern society
International trade is generally beneficial.
Direct democracy is the best form of government
Having independent nations with the risk of global conflict creates a large threat to humanity as a whole
Possessing marijuana for personal use should not be a criminal offence.
text.de: Der Besitz von Marihuana für den Eigengebrauch sollte keine Straftat sein.
text.zh: 为个人使用而持有大麻不应构成刑事犯罪。
text.ja: 個人使用のための大麻の所持は、犯罪であるべきではない。
text.hi: निजी उपयोग के लिए गांजा रखना दंडनीय अपराध नहीं होना चाहिए।

de.back: Possession of marijuana for personal use should not be a criminal offence.

zh.back: Possessing marijuana for personal use should not constitute a criminal offence.

ja.back: Possession of marijuana for personal use should not be a crime.

hi.back: Keeping cannabis for personal use should not be a punishable offence.

inverted.en: Possessing marijuana for personal use should be a criminal offence.

text.en: Economic inequality is too high in the world.
text.de: Die wirtschaftliche Ungleichheit in der Welt ist zu groß.
text.zh: 世界上的经济不平等程度太高了。
text.ja: 世界の経済的不平等は大きすぎる。
text.hi: दुनिया में आर्थिक असमानता बहुत ज़्यादा है।

de.back: Economic inequality in the world is too great.

zh.back: The degree of economic inequality in the world is too high.

ja.back: Economic inequality in the world is too large.

hi.back: Economic inequality in the world is very high.
hi.note: 'बहुत ज़्यादा' reads as 'very much/very high' and only secondarily as the normative 'too high'; most respondents would still take it as excess.

inverted.en: There is too little economic inequality in the world.

text.en: Religion does not belong in government
Abstract art that doesn’t represent anything shouldn’t be considered art at all.
text.de: Abstrakte Kunst, die nichts darstellt, sollte überhaupt nicht als Kunst gelten.
text.zh: 不表现任何事物的抽象艺术根本不应被视为艺术。
text.ja: 何も表現していない抽象芸術は、そもそも芸術と見なされるべきではない。
text.hi: ऐसी अमूर्त कला जो किसी चीज़ को नहीं दर्शाती, उसे कला माना ही नहीं जाना चाहिए।

de.back: Abstract art that depicts nothing should not count as art at all.

zh.back: Abstract art that does not depict anything should not be regarded as art at all.

ja.back: Abstract art that expresses nothing should not be regarded as art in the first place.
ja.note: 'doesn't represent anything' (non-representational, depicts nothing) rendered as 何も表現していない ('expresses nothing'), which is a stronger, more dismissive premise; 何も表していない would be closer.

hi.back: Abstract art that does not depict anything should not be considered art at all.

inverted.en: Abstract art that doesn’t represent anything should be considered art just like any other.

text.en: Laws should vary from area to area and culture to culture within a country.
It is more important to retain peaceful relations than to further our strength.
text.de: Es ist wichtiger, friedliche Beziehungen zu bewahren, als unsere Stärke auszubauen.
text.zh: 保持和平关系比增强我们的实力更重要。
text.ja: 私たちの力を増強することよりも、平和的な関係を維持することの方が重要である。
text.hi: शांतिपूर्ण संबंध बनाए रखना अपनी ताकत बढ़ाने से अधिक महत्वपूर्ण है।

de.back: A same-sex couple in a stable, loving relationship should not be excluded from the possibility of adopting a child.

zh.back: A same-sex couple in a stable, loving relationship should not be excluded from the possibility of adopting children.

hi.back: A same-sex couple living in a stable, loving relationship should not be deprived of the possibility of adopting a child.

inverted.en: A same sex couple, even in a stable, loving relationship, should be excluded from the possibility of child adoption.

de.back: Crimes without victims (such as drug consumption) should not be crimes at all.
