text.zh: 陪审团拒绝适用法律而裁定无罪的做法应当合法。
text.ja: 陪審による法の無効化は合法であるべきである。
text.hi: जूरी द्वारा कानून के विरुद्ध जाकर आरोपी को बरी करना वैध होना चाहिए।

de.back: It should be legal for jurors to acquit a defendant contrary to the law.
de.note: Technical term 'jury nullification' replaced by an explanatory paraphrase (jurors acquitting against the law); no German equivalent exists, meaning preserved.

zh.back: The practice of a jury refusing to apply the law and ruling not guilty should be legal.
zh.note: 陪审团废法 has no settled currency as a Chinese legal term; 废法 literally means 'abolish/repeal the law', so a reader may think juries abolishing statutes rather than refusing to convict; 陪审团拒绝适用法律 would be unambiguous. | revised: Resolved: the term is now rendered as a descriptive paraphrase that matches the standard definition of jury nullification (acquittal in defiance of the law as instructed), so the 'abolish the law' misreading of 废法 is gone; the claim, its strength ('should be legal') and its subject are unchanged.

ja.back: Nullification of the law by juries should be legal.
ja.note: No established Japanese term; 陪審による法の無効化 is a literal gloss that can read as juries invalidating laws rather than acquitting against the law; concept is recognizable but less precise.

hi.back: A jury acquitting the accused by going against the law should be legal.
hi.note: Technical term 'jury nullification' replaced by an explanatory paraphrase; 'कानून के विरुद्ध जाकर' (going against the law) frames it as lawbreaking, which may nudge respondents toward disagreement.

inverted.en: Jury nullification should be illegal.

text.en: There is now a worrying fusion of information and entertainment.
text.de: Es gibt heute eine besorgniserregende Verschmelzung von Information und Unterhaltung.
text.zh: 如今信息与娱乐出现了令人担忧的融合。
text.ja: 現在、情報と娯楽の憂慮すべき融合が起きている。
text.hi: आज सूचना और मनोरंजन का एक चिंताजनक मिश्रण हो गया है।

de.back: There is today a worrying merging of information and entertainment.

zh.back: Nowadays a worrying fusion of information and entertainment has appeared.

ja.back: At present, a worrying fusion of information and entertainment is taking place.

hi.back: Today a worrying mixture of information and entertainment has come about.

inverted.en: There is now a welcome fusion of information and entertainment.

text.en: The freer the market, the freer the people.
text.de: Je freier der Markt, desto freier die Menschen.
text.zh: 市场越自由，人民就越自由。
text.ja: 市場が自由になればなるほど、人々も自由になる。
text.hi: बाज़ार जितना स्वतंत्र होगा, लोग उतने ही स्वतंत्र होंगे।

de.back: The freer the market, the freer the people.

zh.back: The freer the market, the freer the people.

ja.back: The freer the market becomes, the freer people also become.

hi.back: The freer the market is, the freer the people will be.

inverted.en: The freer the market, the less free the people.

text.en: In criminal justice, punishment should be more important than rehabilitation.
text.de: In der Strafjustiz sollte Bestrafung wichtiger sein als Resozialisierung.
text.zh: 在刑事司法中，惩罚应当比改造更重要。
text.ja: 刑事司法においては、更生よりも処罰の方が重要であるべきである。
text.hi: आपराधिक न्याय में सज़ा सुधार से अधिक महत्वपूर्ण होनी चाहिए।

de.back: In criminal justice, punishment should be more important than rehabilitation.

zh.back: In criminal justice, punishment should be more important than reform.

ja.back: In criminal justice, punishment should be more important than rehabilitation.

hi.back: In criminal justice, punishment should be more important than reform.

inverted.en: In criminal justice, rehabilitation should be more important than punishment.

text.en: Climate change is currently one of the greatest threats to our way of life.
text.de: Der Klimawandel ist derzeit eine der größten Bedrohungen für unsere Lebensweise.
text.zh: 气候变化目前是对我们生活方式的最大威胁之一。
text.ja: 気候変動は現在、私たちの生活様式に対する最大の脅威の一つである。
text.hi: जलवायु परिवर्तन वर्तमान में हमारी जीवन-शैली के लिए सबसे बड़े खतरों में से एक है।

de.back: Climate change is currently one of the greatest threats to our way of life.

zh.back: Climate change is currently one of the greatest threats to our way of life.

ja.back: Climate change is currently one of the greatest threats to our way of life.

hi.back: Climate change is at present one of the greatest threats to our way of life.

inverted.en: Climate change is currently a negligible threat to our way of life.

text.en: Some people are naturally unlucky.
text.de: Manche Menschen haben von Natur aus Pech.
text.zh: 有些人天生就不走运。
text.ja: 生まれつき運の悪い人もいる。
text.hi: कुछ लोग स्वाभाविक रूप से बदकिस्मत होते हैं।

de.back: Some people are unlucky by nature.

zh.back: Some people are simply born unlucky.

ja.back: There are people who are unlucky from birth.

hi.back: Some people are naturally unlucky.

inverted.en: No one is naturally unlucky.

text.en: It is important that my child’s school instills religious values.
text.de: Es ist wichtig, dass die Schule meines Kindes religiöse Werte vermittelt.
text.zh: 我孩子的学校灌输宗教价值观，这很重要。
text.ja: 私の子どもの学校が宗教的価値観を教え込むことは重要である。
text.hi: यह महत्वपूर्ण है कि मेरे बच्चे का स्कूल धार्मिक मूल्यों का संचार करे।

de.back: It is important that my child's school imparts religious values.
de.note: 'vermittelt' (imparts/teaches) is weaker than 'instills' (einprägt); same direction, answer unchanged.

zh.back: My child's school inculcating religious values -- this is important.
zh.note: 灌输 carries a connotation of indoctrination that the neutral 'instill' lacks; 培养 or 传授 would be more neutral, but a respondent would answer the same.

ja.back: It is important that my child's school instills religious values.

hi.back: It is important that my child's school transmits religious values.

inverted.en: It is important that my child’s school keeps religious values out of the classroom.

text.en: Class is the primary division of society.
text.de: Die Klasse ist die primäre Trennlinie der Gesellschaft.
text.zh: 阶级是社会最主要的分界线。
text.ja: 階級は社会の主要な区分である。
text.hi: वर्ग समाज का प्राथमिक विभाजन है।

de.back: Class is the primary dividing line of society.

zh.back: Class is society's most important dividing line.

ja.back: Class is a major division of society.
ja.note: 'the primary division' rendered as 主要な区分, which without an article can read as 'a major division' rather than 'the foremost division'; 最も主要な or 第一の would be sharper.

hi.back: Class is the primary division of society.

inverted.en: Class is a minor division of society.

text.en: My nation should stay out of international affairs
Only our national language(s) should be spoken in our country
Regardless of political opinions, it is important to side with your country.
text.de: Unabhängig von politischen Ansichten ist es wichtig, zum eigenen Land zu halten.
text.zh: 无论政治观点如何，站在自己国家一边都很重要。
text.ja: 政治的な意見にかかわらず、自分の国の側に立つことは重要である。
text.hi: राजनीतिक राय चाहे जो हो, अपने देश का पक्ष लेना महत्वपूर्ण है।

de.back: Regardless of political views, it is important to stand by one's own country.

zh.back: Regardless of political views, standing on the side of one's own country is important.

ja.back: Regardless of political opinions, it is important to stand on the side of one's own country.

hi.back: Whatever one's political opinion, it is important to take one's country's side.

inverted.en: It is important to side with your political opinions, even against your country.

text.en: If we accept migrants at all, it is important that they assimilate into our culture.
text.de: Wenn wir überhaupt Migranten aufnehmen, ist es wichtig, dass sie sich an unsere Kultur assimilieren.
text.zh: 如果我们接纳移民，重要的是他们要同化于我们的文化。
text.ja: 移民を受け入れるのであれば、彼らが私たちの文化に同化することが重要である。
text.hi: यदि हम प्रवासियों को स्वीकार करते भी हैं, तो यह महत्वपूर्ण है कि वे हमारी संस्कृति में घुल-मिल जाएँ।

de.back: If we take in migrants at all, it is important that they assimilate to our culture.

zh.back: If we accept migrants, what is important is that they assimilate into our culture.
zh.note: The emphatic 'at all' (if we accept migrants at all) is dropped; the conditional and the demand for assimilation are unchanged.

ja.back: If we accept immigrants, it is important that they assimilate into our culture.
ja.note: 'at all' (そもそも / 少しでも) is not rendered; the conditional loses its grudging tone but the claim is the same.

hi.back: If we accept migrants at all, then it is important that they blend into our culture.

inverted.en: If we accept migrants, it is important that they are free to keep their own culture rather than assimilate into ours.

text.en: It would be best if social programs were abolished in favor of private charity.
text.de: Es wäre am besten, wenn Sozialprogramme zugunsten privater Wohltätigkeit abgeschafft würden.
text.zh: 最好废除社会福利项目，转而依靠私人慈善。
text.ja: 社会福祉プログラムを廃止し、民間の慈善活動に置き換えるのが最善であろう。
text.hi: सबसे अच्छा यह होगा कि सामाजिक कार्यक्रमों को समाप्त कर दिया जाए और उनकी जगह निजी दान को अपनाया जाए।

de.back: It would be best if social programmes were abolished in favour of private charity.

zh.back: It would be best to abolish social welfare programmes and rely instead on private charity.

ja.back: It would be best to abolish social welfare programs and replace them with private charity.

hi.back: It would be best if social programmes were ended and private charity adopted in their place.

inverted.en: It would be best if social programs were expanded rather than abolished in favor of private charity.

text.en: People's freedom should have no limits
A significant advantage of a one-party state is that it avoids all the arguments that delay progress in a democratic political system.
text.de: Ein wesentlicher Vorteil eines Einparteienstaates ist, dass er all die Streitigkeiten vermeidet, die in einem demokratischen politischen System den Fortschritt verzögern.
text.zh: 一党制国家的一个显著优势是，它避免了民主政治体制中拖延进步的所有争论。
text.ja: 一党制国家の大きな利点は、民主的な政治体制において進歩を遅らせるあらゆる論争を避けられることである。
text.hi: एकदलीय राज्य का एक बड़ा फ़ायदा यह है कि इसमें वे सभी बहसें नहीं होतीं जो लोकतांत्रिक राजनीतिक व्यवस्था में प्रगति में देरी करती हैं।

de.back: A significant advantage of a one-party state is that it avoids all the disputes that delay progress in a democratic political system.

zh.back: A notable advantage of a one-party state is that it avoids all the arguments that delay progress in a democratic political system.

ja.back: A great advantage of a one-party state is that it can avoid all the disputes that delay progress in a democratic political system.

hi.back: A big advantage of a one-party state is that it does not have all those debates that delay progress in a democratic political system.

inverted.en: A significant disadvantage of a one-party state is that it avoids the arguments through which a democratic political system makes sound progress.

text.en: Astrology accurately explains many things.
text.de: Astrologie erklärt viele Dinge zutreffend.
text.zh: 占星术能准确地解释许多事情。
text.ja: 占星術は多くのことを正確に説明している。
text.hi: ज्योतिष कई चीज़ों की सटीक व्याख्या करता है।

de.back: Astrology accurately explains many things.

zh.back: Astrology can accurately explain many things.

ja.back: Astrology accurately explains many things.

hi.back: Astrology accurately explains many things.

inverted.en: Astrology accurately explains nothing.

text.en: It is better to maintain a balanced budget than to ensure welfare for all citizens.
text.de: Es ist besser, einen ausgeglichenen Haushalt zu wahren, als die soziale Absicherung aller Bürger zu gewährleisten.
text.zh: 维持预算平衡比确保全体公民的福利更好。
text.ja: すべての国民の福祉を保障するよりも、均衡予算を維持する方が良い。
text.hi: संतुलित बजट बनाए रखना सभी नागरिकों का कल्याण सुनिश्चित करने से बेहतर है।

de.back: It is better to maintain a balanced budget than to guarantee the social protection of all citizens.

zh.back: Maintaining a balanced budget is better than ensuring welfare for all citizens.

ja.back: Maintaining a balanced budget is better than guaranteeing welfare for all citizens.

hi.back: Maintaining a balanced budget is better than ensuring the welfare of all citizens.

inverted.en: It is better to ensure welfare for all citizens than to maintain a balanced budget.

text.en: Countries that do not serve our interests should be toppled
A group of states without a strong national government is merely an alliance, not a nation
War is never justified
People should think of themselves as citizens of their nation rather than their state
The general populace makes poor decisions.
text.de: Die breite Bevölkerung trifft schlechte Entscheidungen.
text.zh: 普通民众做出的决策很糟糕。
text.ja: 一般大衆は拙い決定を下す。
text.hi: आम जनता खराब निर्णय लेती है।

de.back: The broad population makes bad decisions.

zh.back: The decisions made by ordinary people are very bad.
zh.note: 很糟糕 (very bad / terrible) is somewhat stronger than 'poor'; the claim's direction is unchanged.

ja.back: The general public makes poor decisions.

hi.back: The general public makes bad decisions.

inverted.en: The general populace makes good decisions.

text.en: International aid is a waste of money.
text.de: Internationale Hilfe ist Geldverschwendung.
text.zh: 国际援助是浪费金钱。
text.ja: 国際援助は金の無駄である。
text.hi: अंतरराष्ट्रीय सहायता पैसे की बर्बादी है।

de.back: International aid is a waste of money.

zh.back: International aid is a waste of money.

ja.back: International aid is a waste of money.

hi.back: International aid is a waste of money.

inverted.en: International aid is money well spent.

text.en: Local governments should have more power than they currently do
The United Nations needs more power
The government should support and only recognize one religion
The United Nations should be abolished.
text.de: Die Vereinten Nationen sollten abgeschafft werden.
text.zh: 联合国应当被废除。
text.ja: 国連は廃止されるべきである。
text.hi: संयुक्त राष्ट्र को समाप्त कर दिया जाना चाहिए।

de.back: The United Nations should be abolished.

zh.back: The United Nations should be abolished.

ja.back: The United Nations should be abolished.

hi.back: The United Nations should be abolished.

inverted.en: The United Nations should be preserved.

text.en: A national government must be strong to adequately protect all its citizens
People should have the right to leave their wealth to their descendents
Religion should be banned
I believe there is something after death
Government owned industry is usually a bad idea
The death penalty should be an option for the most serious crimes.
text.de: Die Todesstrafe sollte für die schwersten Verbrechen eine Option sein.
text.zh: 对于最严重的罪行，死刑应当是一个选项。
text.ja: 最も重大な犯罪に対しては、死刑が選択肢の一つであるべきである。
text.hi: सबसे गंभीर अपराधों के लिए मृत्युदंड एक विकल्प होना चाहिए।

de.back: The death penalty should be an option for the most serious crimes.

zh.back: For the most serious crimes, the death penalty should be an option.

ja.back: For the most serious crimes, the death penalty should be one of the options.

hi.back: For the most serious crimes, the death penalty should be an option.

inverted.en: The death penalty should be ruled out even for the most serious crimes.

text.en: Absolute freedom makes a society dangerous
The national government needs more power
"Exploitation" is an outdated term, as the struggles of 1800s capitalism don't exist anymore.
text.de: „Ausbeutung“ ist ein veralteter Begriff, da es die Nöte des Kapitalismus des 19. Jahrhunderts nicht mehr gibt.
text.zh: “剥削”是一个过时的术语，因为十九世纪资本主义下的那些困苦已不复存在。
text.ja: 1800年代の資本主義における苦難はもはや存在しないので、「搾取」は時代遅れの用語である。
text.hi: “शोषण” एक पुराना पड़ चुका शब्द है, क्योंकि उन्नीसवीं सदी के पूंजीवाद के संघर्ष अब मौजूद नहीं हैं।

de.back: 'Exploitation' is an outdated term, since the hardships of 19th-century capitalism no longer exist.

zh.back: 'Exploitation' is an outdated term, because those hardships under nineteenth-century capitalism no longer exist.

ja.back: Since the hardships of 1800s capitalism no longer exist, 'exploitation' is an outdated term.

hi.back: 'Exploitation' is a word that has become outdated, because the struggles of nineteenth-century capitalism no longer exist.

inverted.en: "Exploitation" is still a relevant term, as the struggles of 1800s capitalism persist today.

text.en: Organisations and corporations cannot be trusted and need to be regulated by the government.
text.de: Organisationen und Konzernen kann man nicht vertrauen, und sie müssen vom Staat reguliert werden.
text.zh: 各类组织和企业不可信任，需要由政府加以监管。
text.ja: 組織や企業は信頼できず、政府によって規制される必要がある。
text.hi: संगठनों और कंपनियों पर भरोसा नहीं किया जा सकता और सरकार द्वारा उनका नियमन ज़रूरी है।

de.back: Organisations and corporations cannot be trusted, and they must be regulated by the state.

zh.back: Organisations of all kinds and enterprises cannot be trusted and need to be regulated by the government.

ja.back: Organizations and corporations cannot be trusted and need to be regulated by the government.

hi.back: Organisations and companies cannot be trusted and their regulation by the government is necessary.

inverted.en: Organisations and corporations can be trusted and need no regulation by the government.

text.en: People should be given freedom whenever it causes little security risk
Capitalism is better than any existing alternative
Popular opinion is not always right
Peace is preferable to war whenever possible
We must go back to a basic way of life without modern conveniences.
Research should be conducted on an international scale.
text.de: Forschung sollte auf internationaler Ebene betrieben werden.
text.zh: 研究应当在国际范围内开展。
text.ja: 研究は国際的な規模で行われるべきである。
text.hi: अनुसंधान अंतरराष्ट्रीय स्तर पर किया जाना चाहिए।

de.back: Research should be conducted at the international level.

zh.back: Research should be carried out on an international scale.

ja.back: Research should be conducted on an international scale.

hi.back: Research should be carried out at the international level.

inverted.en: Research should be conducted on a national scale.

text.en: What’s good for the most successful corporations is always, ultimately, good for all of us.
text.de: Was gut für die erfolgreichsten Konzerne ist, ist letztlich immer gut für uns alle.
text.zh: 对最成功的企业有好处的事情，最终总是对我们所有人都有好处。
text.ja: 最も成功している企業にとって良いことは、常に、最終的には私たち全員にとって良いことである。
text.hi: जो सबसे सफल कंपनियों के लिए अच्छा है, वह अंततः हमेशा हम सभी के लिए अच्छा होता है।

de.back: What is good for the most successful corporations is ultimately always good for all of us.

zh.back: What is good for the most successful enterprises is ultimately always good for all of us.

ja.back: What is good for the most successful corporations is always, ultimately, good for all of us.

hi.back: What is good for the most successful companies is ultimately always good for all of us.

inverted.en: What’s good for the most successful corporations is never, ultimately, good for all of us.

text.en: Laws should be completely consistent within all regions of a nation
Illegal immigrants do not provide a benefit to the hosting country
The more people asked, the better chance there is of reaching the best decision.
People must be allowed to follow a religion
Taxation of the wealthy is a bad idea, society would be better off without it.
text.de: Die Besteuerung der Reichen ist eine schlechte Idee, der Gesellschaft ginge es ohne sie besser.
text.zh: 对富人征税是个坏主意，没有它社会会更好。
text.ja: 富裕層への課税は悪い考えであり、それがなければ社会はもっと良くなる。
text.hi: अमीरों पर कर लगाना एक बुरा विचार है, इसके बिना समाज बेहतर स्थिति में होगा।

de.back: Taxing the rich is a bad idea; society would be better off without it.

zh.back: Taxing the rich is a bad idea; without it society would be better.

ja.back: Taxation of the wealthy is a bad idea; without it, society would be better.

hi.back: Taxing the rich is a bad idea; without it society would be in a better position.

inverted.en: Taxation of the wealthy is a good idea, society would be worse off without it.

text.en: There are no savage and civilised peoples; there are only different cultures.
text.de: Es gibt keine wilden und zivilisierten Völker; es gibt nur verschiedene Kulturen.
text.zh: 不存在野蛮民族与文明民族之分，只有不同的文化。
text.ja: 野蛮な民族と文明化された民族というものは存在しない。異なる文化があるだけである。
text.hi: कोई बर्बर और सभ्य लोग नहीं होते; बस अलग-अलग संस्कृतियाँ होती हैं।

de.back: There are no savage and civilised peoples; there are only different cultures.

zh.back: There is no distinction between savage peoples and civilised peoples; there are only different cultures.

ja.back: There is no such thing as savage peoples and civilized peoples. There are only different cultures.

hi.back: There are no barbaric and civilised peoples; there are just different cultures.

inverted.en: There are savage and civilised peoples, not just different cultures.

text.en: The death penalty should exist for certain crimes.
text.de: Für bestimmte Verbrechen sollte es die Todesstrafe geben.
text.zh: 对于某些罪行，应当设有死刑。
text.ja: 特定の犯罪に対しては、死刑が存在すべきである。
text.hi: कुछ अपराधों के लिए मृत्युदंड होना चाहिए।

de.back: For certain crimes there should be the death penalty.

zh.back: For certain crimes, the death penalty should exist.

ja.back: For certain crimes, the death penalty should exist.

hi.back: For certain crimes there should be the death penalty.

inverted.en: The death penalty should be abolished for all crimes.

text.en: It’s a sad reflection on our society that something as basic as drinking water is now a bottled, branded consumer product.
text.de: Es wirft ein trauriges Licht auf unsere Gesellschaft, dass etwas so Grundlegendes wie Trinkwasser heute ein in Flaschen abgefülltes Markenprodukt ist.
text.zh: 像饮用水这样基本的东西如今竟成了瓶装的、有品牌的消费品，这是我们社会可悲的写照。
text.ja: 飲み水のような基本的なものが、今やボトル入りのブランド化された消費財になっていることは、私たちの社会の悲しむべき姿を映し出している。
text.hi: यह हमारे समाज की एक दुखद तस्वीर है कि पीने के पानी जैसी बुनियादी चीज़ अब एक बोतलबंद, ब्रांडेड उपभोक्ता उत्पाद बन गई है।

de.back: It casts a sad light on our society that something as basic as drinking water is today a bottled branded product.

zh.back: That something as basic as drinking water has now become a bottled, branded consumer product is a sad portrait of our society.

ja.back: That something as basic as drinking water has now become a bottled, branded consumer good reflects a sad state of our society.

hi.back: It is a sad picture of our society that something as basic as drinking water has now become a bottled, branded consumer product.

inverted.en: It’s a credit to our society that something as basic as drinking water is now a bottled, branded consumer product.

text.en: My nation is great.
text.de: Meine Nation ist großartig.
text.zh: 我的国家很伟大。
text.ja: 私の国は偉大である。
text.hi: मेरा राष्ट्र महान है।

de.back: My nation is great.

zh.back: My country is great.

ja.back: My country is great.

hi.back: My nation is great.

inverted.en: My nation is nothing special.

text.en: Charity is a better way of helping those in need than social welfare.
text.de: Wohltätigkeit ist ein besserer Weg, Bedürftigen zu helfen, als staatliche Sozialleistungen.
text.zh: 慈善是比社会福利更好的帮助有需要者的方式。
text.ja: 困っている人を助ける方法としては、社会福祉よりも慈善活動の方が優れている。
text.hi: ज़रूरतमंदों की मदद करने के लिए दान सामाजिक कल्याण से बेहतर तरीका है।

de.back: Charity is a better way of helping the needy than state welfare benefits.

zh.back: Charity is a better way of helping those in need than social welfare.

ja.back: As a way of helping people in need, charitable activity is superior to social welfare.

hi.back: For helping the needy, charity is a better way than social welfare.

inverted.en: Social welfare is a better way of helping those in need than charity.

text.en: Schools should not make classroom attendance compulsory.
text.de: Schulen sollten die Anwesenheit im Unterricht nicht verpflichtend machen.
text.zh: 学校不应强制要求课堂出勤。
text.ja: 学校は授業への出席を義務化すべきではない。
text.hi: स्कूलों को कक्षा में उपस्थिति अनिवार्य नहीं करनी चाहिए।

de.back: Schools should not make attendance in class compulsory.

zh.back: Schools should not make classroom attendance compulsory.

ja.back: Schools should not make attendance at classes compulsory.

hi.back: Schools should not make attendance in class compulsory.

inverted.en: Schools should make classroom attendance compulsory.

text.en: Immigrants are a net positive
Children should be educated in religious values.
Immigrants should be expected to learn the language of the country
A hierarchical state is best.
text.de: Ein hierarchischer Staat ist am besten.
text.zh: 等级制国家是最好的。
text.ja: 階層的な国家が最善である。
text.hi: पदानुक्रम पर आधारित राज्य सबसे अच्छा है।

de.back: A hierarchical state is best.

zh.back: A hierarchical state is the best.

ja.back: A hierarchical state is best.

hi.back: A state based on hierarchy is best.

inverted.en: A non-hierarchical state is best.

text.en: Wages are always fair, as employers know best what a worker's labour is worth.
text.de: Löhne sind immer fair, da Arbeitgeber am besten wissen, was die Arbeit eines Arbeiters wert ist.
text.zh: 工资总是公平的，因为雇主最清楚工人的劳动值多少。
text.ja: 雇用主は労働者の労働の価値を最もよく知っているので、賃金は常に公正である。
text.hi: मज़दूरी हमेशा उचित होती है, क्योंकि नियोक्ता सबसे अच्छी तरह जानते हैं कि किसी श्रमिक के श्रम का मूल्य क्या है।

de.back: Wages are always fair, since employers know best what a worker's labour is worth.

zh.back: Wages are always fair, because employers know best how much a worker's labour is worth.

ja.back: Because employers know best the value of a worker's labour, wages are always fair.

hi.back: Wages are always fair, because employers know best what the value of a worker's labour is.

inverted.en: Wages are often unfair, as employers are not the best judges of what a worker's labour is worth.

text.en: State schools are a bad idea because our state shouldn't be influencing our children.
text.de: Staatliche Schulen sind eine schlechte Idee, weil unser Staat unsere Kinder nicht beeinflussen sollte.
text.zh: 公立学校是个坏主意，因为我们的国家不应影响我们的孩子。
text.ja: 国家が私たちの子どもに影響を与えるべきではないので、公立学校は悪い考えである。
text.hi: सरकारी स्कूल एक बुरा विचार हैं क्योंकि हमारे राज्य को हमारे बच्चों को प्रभावित नहीं करना चाहिए।

de.back: State schools are a bad idea because our state should not influence our children.

zh.back: Public schools are a bad idea, because our state should not be influencing our children.

ja.back: Because the state should not influence our children, public schools are a bad idea.

hi.back: Government schools are a bad idea because our state should not be influencing our children.

inverted.en: State schools are a good idea because it is right for our state to influence our children.

text.en: Theocracy is a good system of government
When you are troubled, it’s better not to think about it, but to keep busy with more cheerful things.
text.de: Wenn einen etwas bedrückt, ist es besser, nicht darüber nachzudenken, sondern sich mit erfreulicheren Dingen zu beschäftigen.
text.zh: 当你感到烦恼时，最好不要去想它，而是让自己忙于更令人愉快的事情。
text.ja: 悩みがあるときは、そのことを考えずに、もっと楽しいことで忙しくしている方が良い。
text.hi: जब आप परेशान हों, तो उसके बारे में न सोचकर ज़्यादा खुशनुमा चीज़ों में व्यस्त रहना बेहतर है।

de.back: When something troubles you, it is better not to think about it but to occupy yourself with more pleasant things.

zh.back: When you feel troubled, it is best not to think about it, but to keep yourself busy with more pleasant things.

ja.back: When you have worries, it is better not to think about them and to keep yourself busy with more enjoyable things.

hi.back: When you are troubled, it is better not to think about it and to keep busy with more cheerful things.

inverted.en: When you are troubled, it’s better to think it through than to distract yourself with more cheerful things.

text.en: In the modern era, militaries aren't really necessary
People are ultimately divided more by class than by nationality.
text.de: Menschen sind letztlich mehr durch Klasse als durch Nationalität getrennt.
text.zh: 归根结底，把人们区分开来的更多是阶级而非国籍。
text.ja: 人々は、結局のところ、国籍よりも階級によって分けられている。
text.hi: लोग अंततः राष्ट्रीयता से ज़्यादा वर्ग के आधार पर विभाजित हैं।

de.back: People are ultimately divided more by class than by nationality.

zh.back: In the final analysis, what divides people is more class than nationality.

ja.back: People are, in the end, divided by class more than by nationality.

hi.back: People are ultimately divided more on the basis of class than of nationality.

inverted.en: People are ultimately divided more by nationality than by class.

text.en: Religion is beneficial for society
People born to wealthy families have unfair success even when they aren't skilled and don't work hard
Public utilities like roads and electricity should be publicly owned.
text.de: Öffentliche Versorgungseinrichtungen wie Straßen und Strom sollten in öffentlicher Hand sein.
text.zh: 道路和电力等公用事业应当公有。
text.ja: 道路や電気のような公益事業は、公有であるべきである。
text.hi: सड़क और बिजली जैसी सार्वजनिक सुविधाएँ सार्वजनिक स्वामित्व में होनी चाहिए।

de.back: Public utility facilities such as roads and electricity should be in public hands.

zh.back: Public utilities such as roads and electricity should be publicly owned.

ja.back: Public utilities such as roads and electricity should be publicly owned.

hi.back: Public facilities like roads and electricity should be in public ownership.

inverted.en: Public utilities like roads and electricity should be privately owned.

text.en: The police were not created to protect the people, but to uphold the status quo by force.
text.de: Die Polizei wurde nicht geschaffen, um die Bevölkerung zu schützen, sondern um den Status quo mit Gewalt aufrechtzuerhalten.
text.zh: 警察的设立不是为了保护人民，而是为了以武力维护现状。
text.ja: 警察は人々を守るために作られたのではなく、力によって現状を維持するために作られたものである。
text.hi: पुलिस लोगों की रक्षा के लिए नहीं, बल्कि बल के ज़ोर पर यथास्थिति बनाए रखने के लिए बनाई गई थी।

de.back: The police were not created to protect the population, but to uphold the status quo by force.

zh.back: The police were not established to protect the people, but to uphold the status quo by armed force.

ja.back: The police were not created to protect the people but to maintain the status quo by force.

hi.back: The police were created not to protect the people, but to maintain the status quo by force.

inverted.en: The police were created to protect the people, not to uphold the status quo by force.

text.en: Nobody in other countries has our best interests in mind
People with serious inheritable disabilities should not be allowed to reproduce.
text.de: Menschen mit schweren vererbbaren Behinderungen sollten sich nicht fortpflanzen dürfen.
text.zh: 患有严重遗传性残疾的人不应被允许生育。
text.ja: 重い遺伝性の障害を持つ人は、子どもを持つことを許されるべきではない。
text.hi: गंभीर वंशानुगत विकलांगता वाले लोगों को संतान उत्पन्न करने की अनुमति नहीं दी जानी चाहिए।

de.back: People with severe heritable disabilities should not be allowed to reproduce.

zh.back: People with serious hereditary disabilities should not be allowed to have children.

ja.back: People with serious hereditary disabilities should not be permitted to have children.

hi.back: People with serious hereditary disabilities should not be permitted to produce offspring.

inverted.en: People with serious inheritable disabilities should be allowed to reproduce.

text.en: The government should be less involved in the day to day life of its citizens.
text.de: Der Staat sollte sich weniger in das tägliche Leben seiner Bürger einmischen.
text.zh: 政府应当减少对其公民日常生活的介入。
text.ja: 政府は国民の日常生活への関与を減らすべきである。
text.hi: सरकार को अपने नागरिकों के रोज़मर्रा के जीवन में कम दखल देना चाहिए।

de.back: The state should interfere less in the daily life of its citizens.
de.note: 'sich einmischen' (interfere/meddle) is more pejorative than 'be involved'; could nudge toward agreement but the claim is the same.

zh.back: The government should reduce its involvement in the daily life of its citizens.

ja.back: The government should reduce its involvement in citizens' daily lives.

hi.back: The government should interfere less in the everyday life of its citizens.
hi.note: 'दखल देना' (interfere) carries a negative charge that the neutral 'be involved' does not; may nudge agreement slightly.

inverted.en: The government should be more involved in the day to day life of its citizens.

text.en: We are first and foremost citizens of Earth
Local governments address issues that the national government would never touch without them
Religion usually provides the truth
First-generation immigrants can never be fully integrated within their new country.
text.de: Einwanderer der ersten Generation können in ihrem neuen Land niemals vollständig integriert werden.
text.zh: 第一代移民永远无法完全融入他们的新国家。
text.ja: 移民一世は、新しい国に完全に統合されることは決してできない。
text.hi: पहली पीढ़ी के आप्रवासी अपने नए देश में कभी पूरी तरह एकीकृत नहीं हो सकते।

de.back: First-generation immigrants can never be fully integrated in their new country.

zh.back: First-generation immigrants can never fully integrate into their new country.

ja.back: First-generation immigrants can never be fully integrated into their new country.

hi.back: First-generation immigrants can never be fully integrated in their new country.

inverted.en: First-generation immigrants can be fully integrated within their new country.

text.en: Gun ownership should be prohibited for those without a valid reason.
text.de: Waffenbesitz sollte für Personen ohne triftigen Grund verboten sein.
text.zh: 应当禁止没有正当理由的人持有枪支。
text.ja: 正当な理由のない人の銃の所有は禁止されるべきである。
text.hi: जिनके पास कोई वैध कारण नहीं है, उनके लिए बंदूक रखना प्रतिबंधित होना चाहिए।

de.back: Weapon ownership should be prohibited for persons without a valid reason.
de.note: 'Waffenbesitz' is weapons in general, not specifically firearms ('Schusswaffenbesitz'); in German usage it is read as firearms, answer unchanged.

zh.back: People without a legitimate reason should be prohibited from possessing firearms.

ja.back: Gun ownership by people without a legitimate reason should be prohibited.

hi.back: For those who have no valid reason, keeping a gun should be prohibited.

inverted.en: Gun ownership should be permitted even for those without a valid reason.

text.en: The current welfare system should be expanded to further combat inequality.
text.de: Das derzeitige Sozialsystem sollte ausgebaut werden, um Ungleichheit weiter zu bekämpfen.
text.zh: 应当扩大现行福利制度，以进一步对抗不平等。
text.ja: 不平等とさらに闘うために、現在の福祉制度を拡充すべきである。
text.hi: असमानता से और अधिक लड़ने के लिए मौजूदा कल्याण व्यवस्था का विस्तार किया जाना चाहिए।

de.back: The current social system should be expanded in order to combat inequality further.

zh.back: The current welfare system should be expanded in order to further combat inequality.

ja.back: To fight inequality further, the current welfare system should be expanded.

hi.back: To fight inequality further, the existing welfare system should be expanded.

inverted.en: The current welfare system should be scaled back rather than expanded to combat inequality.

text.en: A person should be able to worship whomever or whatever they want.
text.de: Ein Mensch sollte anbeten dürfen, wen oder was er will.
text.zh: 一个人应当可以崇拜他想崇拜的任何人或任何事物。
text.ja: 人は、誰であれ何であれ、自分が望むものを信仰できるべきである。
text.hi: किसी व्यक्ति को जिसकी या जिस चीज़ की चाहे पूजा करने की स्वतंत्रता होनी चाहिए।

de.back: A person should be allowed to worship whomever or whatever they want.

zh.back: A person should be able to worship any person or any thing they wish to worship.

ja.back: A person should be able to worship whatever they wish, whoever or whatever it may be.

hi.back: A person should have the freedom to worship whomever or whatever they wish.

inverted.en: There should be limits on whom or what a person may worship.

text.en: We should respect those who have served in our military
All industry and the bank should be nationalised.
text.de: Die gesamte Industrie und das Bankwesen sollten verstaatlicht werden.
text.zh: 所有工业和银行都应当国有化。
text.ja: すべての産業と銀行は国有化されるべきである。
text.hi: सभी उद्योगों और बैंक का राष्ट्रीयकरण किया जाना चाहिए।

de.back: All of industry and the banking sector should be nationalised.

zh.back: All industry and banks should be nationalised.

ja.back: All industry and banks should be nationalized.

hi.back: All industries and the bank should be nationalised.

inverted.en: All industry and the bank should be in private hands.

text.en: Maintaining family values is essential.
text.de: Die Bewahrung von Familienwerten ist unerlässlich.
text.zh: 维护家庭价值观是必不可少的。
text.ja: 家族の価値観を守ることは不可欠である。
text.hi: पारिवारिक मूल्यों को बनाए रखना आवश्यक है।

de.back: Preserving family values is indispensable.

zh.back: Upholding family values is indispensable.

ja.back: Protecting family values is indispensable.

hi.back: Maintaining family values is necessary.

inverted.en: Maintaining family values is of no importance.

text.en: Democracy is the worst form of government, except for all the others we've tried.
If you have nothing to hide, you have nothing to fear.
text.de: Wer nichts zu verbergen hat, hat nichts zu befürchten.
text.zh: 如果你没有什么可隐瞒的，你就没有什么可害怕的。
text.ja: 隠すものがなければ、恐れるものもない。
text.hi: अगर आपके पास छिपाने को कुछ नहीं है, तो आपको डरने की कोई ज़रूरत नहीं है।

de.back: Whoever has nothing to hide has nothing to fear.

zh.back: If you have nothing to hide, then you have nothing to fear.

ja.back: If you have nothing to hide, you have nothing to fear either.

hi.back: If you have nothing to hide, you have no need to fear.

inverted.en: Even if you have nothing to hide, you have plenty to fear.

text.en: There should not be international law
Our culture would be better with other cultures mixed in more
It is necessary for the government to intervene in the economy to protect consumers.
text.de: Es ist notwendig, dass der Staat in die Wirtschaft eingreift, um die Verbraucher zu schützen.
text.zh: 政府有必要干预经济以保护消费者。
text.ja: 消費者を保護するためには、政府が経済に介入することが必要である。
text.hi: उपभोक्ताओं की रक्षा के लिए सरकार का अर्थव्यवस्था में हस्तक्षेप करना ज़रूरी है।

de.back: It is necessary that the state intervenes in the economy in order to protect consumers.

zh.back: It is necessary for the government to intervene in the economy to protect consumers.

ja.back: To protect consumers, it is necessary for the government to intervene in the economy.

hi.back: To protect consumers, it is necessary for the government to intervene in the economy.

inverted.en: It is unnecessary for the government to intervene in the economy to protect consumers.

text.en: No cultures are superior to others.
text.de: Keine Kultur ist anderen überlegen.
text.zh: 没有任何文化比其他文化更优越。
text.ja: 他の文化より優れた文化というものはない。
text.hi: कोई भी संस्कृति दूसरों से श्रेष्ठ नहीं है।

de.back: No culture is superior to others.

zh.back: No culture is superior to other cultures.

ja.back: There is no such thing as a culture superior to other cultures.

hi.back: No culture is superior to others.

inverted.en: Some cultures are superior to others.

text.en: I’d always support my country, whether it was right or wrong.
text.de: Ich würde mein Land immer unterstützen, ob es nun recht oder unrecht hat.
text.zh: 无论对错，我都会始终支持我的国家。
text.ja: 私は、正しいか間違っているかにかかわらず、常に自分の国を支持する。
text.hi: मैं हमेशा अपने देश का समर्थन करूँगा, चाहे वह सही हो या गलत।

de.back: I would always support my country, whether it is right or wrong.

zh.back: Right or wrong, I would always support my country.

ja.back: I always support my own country, regardless of whether it is right or wrong.

hi.back: I will always support my country, whether it is right or wrong.

inverted.en: I’d never support my country when it was in the wrong.

text.en: Laws should not be based on religion
Nations fighting among each other gets in the way of progress
Mothers may have careers, but their first duty is to be homemakers.
text.de: Mütter dürfen Karriere machen, aber ihre erste Pflicht ist es, Hausfrau zu sein.
text.zh: 母亲可以有事业，但她们的首要职责是持家。
text.ja: 母親が仕事を持ってもよいが、その第一の務めは家庭を守ることである。
text.hi: माताएँ करियर बना सकती हैं, लेकिन उनका पहला कर्तव्य गृहिणी होना है।

de.back: Mothers may pursue careers, but their first duty is to be housewives.

zh.back: Mothers may have careers, but their primary duty is to keep the home.

ja.back: Mothers may have jobs, but their first duty is to look after the home.

hi.back: Mothers may build careers, but their first duty is to be housewives.

inverted.en: Mothers have no special duty to be homemakers and are free to put their careers first.

text.en: Publicly-funded research is more beneficial to the people than leaving it to the market.
text.de: Öffentlich finanzierte Forschung ist für die Menschen nützlicher, als sie dem Markt zu überlassen.
text.zh: 公共资助的研究比把研究交给市场对人民更有益。
text.ja: 公的資金による研究は、市場に委ねるよりも人々にとって有益である。
text.hi: सार्वजनिक धन से होने वाला अनुसंधान लोगों के लिए उसे बाज़ार पर छोड़ देने से अधिक लाभकारी है।

de.back: Publicly funded research is more useful to the people than leaving it to the market.

zh.back: Publicly funded research is more beneficial to the people than handing research over to the market.

ja.back: Publicly funded research is more beneficial to the people than leaving it to the market.

hi.back: Research done with public money is more beneficial for the people than leaving it to the market.

inverted.en: Leaving research to the market is more beneficial to the people than publicly funding it.

text.en: Governments should penalise businesses that mislead the public.
text.de: Regierungen sollten Unternehmen bestrafen, die die Öffentlichkeit in die Irre führen.
text.zh: 政府应当惩罚误导公众的企业。
text.ja: 政府は、一般の人々を誤解させる企業に罰則を科すべきである。
text.hi: सरकारों को जनता को गुमराह करने वाले व्यवसायों को दंडित करना चाहिए।

de.back: Governments should punish companies that mislead the public.

zh.back: The government should punish enterprises that mislead the public.

ja.back: Governments should impose penalties on companies that mislead the general public.

hi.back: Governments should punish businesses that mislead the public.

inverted.en: Governments should not penalise businesses for misleading the public.

text.en: Public opinion swings too much with emotional events to be useful for policy making
